source: Written for this app (not the games' dialogue). Every trainer has three sets of lines; one set is picked per battle. Each greeting fits the trainer's class, look (their sprite) and Alola (places, food, customs), and mentions their team's theme where it has one (all Eeveelutions, all Electric, legendary Pokémon, rain or sun teams...); both closing remarks call back to their greeting. Special trainers and Battle Legends speak in character.

Florian.greeting: These board shorts have been through every tide pool on Melemele. Ready to get soaked?
Florian.trainerWins: Soaked you! The tide pools taught me well.
Florian.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got soaked... I'll go dry off on Route 1.

Florian.greeting: I caught my first Bug-type on Route 1 with a net and a malasada for bait!
Florian.trainerLoses: Guess my bugs want a bigger malasada next time.

Florian.greeting: Arms wide like a Pelipper! That's my Battle Tree pose. You like it?
Florian.trainerWins: The Pelipper pose wins! I'm keeping it forever.
Florian.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe the Pelipper pose needs some work.

Robin.greeting: Every morning I race Yungoos down Hau'oli Beach. I'm fast, and so's my team!
Robin.trainerWins: Faster than a Yungoos on hot sand!
Robin.trainerLoses: You ran me down like a Gumshoos chasing lunch...

Robin.greeting: My Vikavolt hums like a beehive! Bugs are the best, and I'll prove it.
Robin.trainerWins: Bzzz! Told you Bug-types are the best!
Robin.trainerLoses: My bugs buzzed... then fizzled. Back to the meadow.

Robin.greeting: Mom says these shorts are too loud. I say they're lucky! Wanna test 'em?
Robin.trainerLoses: Maybe Mom was right about these shorts...

Max.greeting: I give everything maximum effort, even eating shave ice! Brain freeze can't stop me!
Max.trainerLoses: Ugh... that loss hit harder than a brain freeze.

Max.greeting: I practiced my Z-pose in the mirror all week. Check out these arms!
Max.trainerWins: And THAT'S how you finish with a pose!
Max.trainerLoses: My pose was perfect. My battling... not so much.

Max.greeting: My Beedrill could beat a Totem Pokémon. Probably. Maybe. Let's find out!

Bert.greeting: I spent all summer catching bugs in Melemele Meadow. Look at this sunburn!
Bert.trainerLoses: Sunburned AND beaten. Some summer, huh?

Bert.greeting: Golisopod's my hero. It's a bug that lives in the ocean! Coolest thing ever!
Bert.trainerLoses: Even Golisopod has to retreat sometimes...

Bert.greeting: My big brother finished his island challenge. Now it's my turn to get famous!
Bert.trainerWins: Wait till my brother hears about this!
Bert.trainerLoses: Don't tell my brother. He'll never let me forget it.

Sophia.greeting: I picked this hibiscus for my hair on Route 2. My battling is even prettier!
Sophia.trainerWins: Pretty and victorious, just like my hibiscus!
Sophia.trainerLoses: My hibiscus is wilting... and so am I.

Sophia.greeting: I come straight here after the Trainers' School lets out. Homework can wait!
Sophia.trainerLoses: Maybe I should've done my homework instead...

Sophia.greeting: My Sylveon and I match: both pretty, both dangerous!
Sophia.trainerLoses: Too pretty to win today, I suppose...

Shanta.greeting: I bought this green skirt at a Hau'oli boutique. It's my lucky battle skirt!
Shanta.trainerLoses: Back to the boutique for a luckier color...

Shanta.greeting: Oricorio taught me how to dance. Now my whole team moves with style!
Shanta.trainerWins: And that's how we dance to victory!
Shanta.trainerLoses: We tripped over our own feet...

Shanta.greeting: Let's make this quick. My shave ice is melting in the lobby!
Shanta.trainerWins: Done! And my shave ice is still cold!
Shanta.trainerLoses: My shave ice melted... and so did my pride.

Rachel.greeting: My friends dared me to climb the Battle Tree. I'll send them a victory selfie!
Rachel.trainerLoses: No selfie for this one. Delete, delete, delete...

Rachel.greeting: A win here means bragging rights at the Pokémon Center café!
Rachel.trainerLoses: Guess I'll be quiet at the café today.

Rachel.greeting: My Pelipper walks me to the beach every morning. The Wingull are so jealous!
Rachel.trainerLoses: Even Pelipper looks disappointed in me.

Chan.greeting: I read every battling book in the Malie Library. Chapter one: win!
Chan.trainerLoses: I'll be checking out more books from Malie...

Chan.greeting: My flower clip came from Malie Garden. It's my lucky charm!
Chan.trainerLoses: Maybe I need a new lucky charm...

Chan.greeting: Whimsicott and I love windy days on the Hano Beach cliffs. Ready to get blown away?
Chan.trainerWins: Blown away, just like I said!
Chan.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got blown away...

Ferdinand.greeting: My sun hat keeps the sunshine off, so I can battle all day long!
Ferdinand.trainerWins: My sun hat never lets me down!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: My hat fell off... and so did my winning.

Ferdinand.greeting: Mommy gave me a malasada for being brave. I'm SO brave!
Ferdinand.trainerWins: Brave AND a winner! Mommy owes me another malasada!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: I'm still brave. Just a little sad.

Ferdinand.greeting: Togedemaru is round and spiky, like me when I'm grumpy! Let's battle!
Ferdinand.trainerWins: Spiky and round and happy now!
Ferdinand.trainerLoses: Now I'm grumpy like a Togedemaru...

Rico.greeting: I climbed every step of the Battle Tree with my own legs! I'm big now!
Rico.trainerLoses: Maybe I'm still a little bit small...

Rico.greeting: I built a sandcastle at Hau'oli Beach this morning! Now I'm gonna build a win!
Rico.trainerWins: Win built! Taller than my sandcastle!
Rico.trainerLoses: My win got knocked down like my sandcastle...

Rico.greeting: Bewear gives the BEST hugs. Too strong, though. Ouchie!
Rico.trainerWins: Bewear hug for the winner! That's me!
Rico.trainerLoses: I need a Bewear hug right now...

Rocky.greeting: My team is fire and leaves, like a campfire in the Lush Jungle!
Grandpa took me to see Wela Volcano. Now all my Pokémon are hot hot hot!
Rocky.trainerLoses: Ow, ow, ow. I got burned instead.

Rocky.greeting: My white hat keeps the sun on my Pokémon. They LOVE sunshine!
Rocky.trainerWins: Sunshine power! My hat was right!
Rocky.trainerLoses: Clouds came out... no more sunshine.

Jasper.greeting: I stayed up past bedtime watching Battle Royals on TV. Now it's my turn!
Jasper.trainerLoses: Yawn... I should've gone to bed.

Jasper.greeting: My cousin works at the Hano Grand Resort. He says I can beat anybody!
Audino says I'm healthy enough to battle. Doctor's orders!
Jasper.trainerLoses: I think I need a checkup from Audino...

Kendra.greeting: I'm gonna draw my Pokémon with my orange and green crayons. Fire and leaves!
Kendra.trainerWins: Fire and leaves win! Drawing time!
Kendra.trainerLoses: I'll draw you instead. You were really good.

Kendra.greeting: Ninetales makes the sun come out! Sunny days are my favorite days!
My cap is white like a cloud, but my Pokémon are hot like beach sand!
Kendra.trainerWins: Hot sand, hot Pokémon, hot win! Ouch, ouch, yay!

Mercy.greeting: My big sister says I'm too little to battle here. Hmph! Watch me!
Mercy.trainerWins: Too little? Ha! Wait till I tell my big sister!
Mercy.trainerLoses: Don't tell my big sister, okay?

Mercy.greeting: I made a plumeria lei for my Comfey. Now we're both pretty!
This is my battle dress! It has little Pokémon on it!
Mercy.trainerLoses: My battle dress is all dirty now...

Helen.greeting: Lopunny has the softest ears in all of Alola! Wanna see them win?
Helen.trainerLoses: Lopunny's ears are all droopy now...

Helen.greeting: We had a luau at my house last night! I'm still full of energy!
Helen.trainerWins: Luau energy wins! I could battle all night!
Helen.trainerLoses: I think the luau energy wore off...

Helen.greeting: My cap keeps the sun out of my eyes, so I can see you lose!
Helen.trainerWins: I saw it all! You lost!
Helen.trainerLoses: I saw it all... I lost.

Gladys.greeting: If I win, Grandpa's taking me to the malasada shop in Hau'oli! Sweet ones!
Gladys.trainerLoses: I'll get a sour malasada... to match my mood.

Gladys.greeting: Kangaskhan carries her baby in a pouch. I wish my mommy had a pouch!
Gladys.trainerLoses: I wanna go back to my mommy now...

Gladys.greeting: I wore my best dress to the Battle Tree! Do I look like a champion?
Gladys.trainerWins: I look like a champion AND I am one!
Gladys.trainerLoses: I look like a champion. I just didn't battle like one.

Darla.greeting: This backpack has been to every island in Alola. It's heavier than a Mudsdale!
Darla.trainerLoses: Now my backpack feels even heavier...

Darla.greeting: Thumbs up! I hitched a Tauros ride from Paniola Ranch just for this!
Darla.trainerLoses: Thumbs... down. Long Tauros ride home.

Darla.greeting: I mark every battle I win on my map. Let's put a star on Poni Island!
Darla.trainerWins: Gold star on the map for Poni Island!
Darla.trainerLoses: This spot gets a little frowny face.

Tammy.greeting: My Pokémon are slow, heavy and proud of it. Ever heard of Trick Room?
Tammy.trainerWins: Slow and steady wins up here!
Tammy.trainerLoses: Too slow even for Trick Room...

Tammy.greeting: I packed Slowking, Hippowdon and a whole lot of patience. Let's take our time!
Tammy.trainerWins: Patience pays off! Slowking would nod if it weren't so slow.
Tammy.trainerLoses: We took our time... and ran out of it.

Tammy.greeting: Thumbs up! I walked here from Seafolk Village. Slowly. Very slowly.
Tammy.trainerLoses: Long, slow walk back to Seafolk...

Reese.greeting: Everything I carry is heavy: my bag AND my team. Let's twist some dimensions!
Reese.trainerLoses: The dimensions twisted right back on me...

Reese.greeting: I collect a souvenir from every town. Malie has the best ones. Today: a win!
Reese.trainerWins: Best souvenir yet! Way better than a Malie key chain.
Reese.trainerLoses: A loss... not the souvenir I wanted.

Reese.greeting: My Walrein and I nap on the Poni coast between battles. We're well rested!
Reese.trainerLoses: Time for another nap, I think...

Kayla.greeting: I've hiked every trail on Akala, from Brooklet Hill to the volcano. Let's go!
Thumbs up, straps tight! I'm ready for anything you throw at me!
Kayla.trainerWins: Ready for anything, and anything included you!

Kayla.greeting: Manectric lights up my campsite at night. It's got plenty of charge left for you!
Kayla.trainerWins: Fully charged! Manectric could light the whole campsite now.
Kayla.trainerLoses: Manectric's out of juice. Lights out at camp.

Cleavant.greeting: Hah! I've hauled this pack to the top of Mount Lanakila three times!
Cleavant.trainerLoses: This tree is steeper than Lanakila ever was...

Cleavant.greeting: I dig for fossils in the Ten Carat Hill caves. Ancient power, coming through!
Cleavant.trainerWins: Ancient power wins! These fossils still have it!

Cleavant.greeting: My bandana's soaked with the sweat of a thousand climbs. Let's add one more!
Cleavant.trainerWins: One more climb, one more win!
Cleavant.trainerLoses: Too much sweat, not enough strength...

Buster.greeting: Hohoho! My rock-solid team crushes opponents like Ten Carat Hill gravel!
Buster.trainerWins: Gravel, just like I promised! Hohoho!

Buster.greeting: Alolan Golem is magnetic! It practically pulled me up this tree!
Buster.trainerWins: A magnetic victory! Golem pulled that one right in! Hohoho!
Buster.trainerLoses: Golem's magnet pulled me down, too...

Buster.greeting: Rock and Ground, solid as the earth beneath my boots! Hohoho!
Buster.trainerWins: Solid as the earth! Nothing moves this mountain! Hohoho!
Buster.trainerLoses: The earth shook... right under me.

Arlo.greeting: I trained in Haina Desert sandstorms. My team loves sand as much as I do!
Arlo.trainerWins: Sand in your eyes? Sorry about that!
Arlo.trainerLoses: The sand settled... and so did my streak.

Arlo.greeting: Tyranitar kicks up the storm, and Excadrill digs right through it. Ready?
Arlo.trainerLoses: Even my sandstorm couldn't hide me.

Arlo.greeting: This beard has seen every trail on Ula'ula. It's never seen me lose!
Arlo.trainerLoses: My beard is ashamed of me...

Levine.greeting: Rock, Steel and Ground. My team is as tough as the cliffs of Vast Poni Canyon!
I carry boulders up Mount Hokulani for training. A battle is a nice break!
Levine.trainerWins: Lighter than a boulder, that battle!
Levine.trainerLoses: That loss weighs more than any boulder.

Levine.greeting: Let the sandstorm roll in! My Pokémon won't even blink.
Levine.trainerWins: Didn't blink once! My team's eyes are tougher than sandpaper.
Levine.trainerLoses: Something got in my eye... it's sand. And tears.

Percy.greeting: I loosened my tie for this battle. That's how serious I am!
Percy.trainerLoses: Better tighten my tie and get back to work...

Percy.greeting: I commute from Hau'oli every morning. Battling on Poni Island is my vacation!
Steel-types never call in sick! My team runs like well-oiled office machines!

Conley.greeting: I've blocked out exactly fifteen minutes in my planner for this battle.
Conley.trainerWins: Finished early! Back to my planner.
Conley.trainerLoses: I'll need to reschedule my whole afternoon...

Conley.greeting: Pau hana! Work's done, so it's battle time!
Conley.trainerWins: Best pau hana ever! Now for a cold drink by the marina.

Conley.greeting: Electivire keeps the office lights on during blackouts. Shocking, isn't it?

Emery.greeting: My confidence is like the stock market on a good day: way up!
Emery.trainerLoses: Market crash... my confidence is in free fall.

Emery.greeting: This is my best white shirt. I'll keep it spotless while I win.
Emery.trainerWins: Not a single stain! Shirt's clean, record's clean.
Emery.trainerLoses: Is that... a stain? Ugh, what a day.

Emery.greeting: I take my lunch at the Hau'oli Marina. Today it's a battle break!
Emery.trainerLoses: Lunch break's over. Back to my desk.

Winnie.greeting: After a long week at the Hau'oli office, a battle is my favorite way to unwind!
Winnie.trainerWins: Totally unwound! Better than a weekend at Hano Beach.
Winnie.trainerLoses: Now I'm wound up tighter than before...

Winnie.greeting: I keep a Comfey on my desk. Its flowers make the whole office smell like Alola!
These slacks are office-ready AND battle-ready. Let's go!

Prudence.greeting: I made a slideshow on my battle strategy. Slide one: you lose.
Prudence.trainerWins: Final slide: I win. Any questions?
Prudence.trainerLoses: Back to slide one... all of them, really.

Prudence.greeting: Sylveon and Florges are our office mascots. Cute, but don't underestimate them!
Prudence.trainerWins: Cute and fierce! Our mascots earned their treats today.

Prudence.greeting: I took the ferry from Akala just for this. It had better be worth it!
Prudence.trainerWins: Worth every wave of that ferry ride!
Prudence.trainerLoses: A long, seasick ferry ride home...

Dominica.greeting: I'm up for a promotion. A Battle Tree win would look great on my résumé!
Dominica.trainerWins: That's going straight on my résumé!
Dominica.trainerLoses: I'll leave this one off the résumé...

Dominica.greeting: My Whimsicott is my fluffy stress ball. Wanna see it go wild?
Dominica.trainerWins: Fluffy and fierce! Best stress ball ever.

Dominica.greeting: I brought a poke bowl for lunch. I'll bring home a win too!
Dominica.trainerWins: Lunch AND a win. So ono!
Dominica.trainerLoses: Lunch was ono. That battle wasn't.

Kass.greeting: Yo! You look like you need a lesson in how we do things in Po Town!
Kass.trainerWins: Lesson over, yo! Hope you took notes!
Kass.trainerLoses: Yo... I think I just got schooled.

Kass.greeting: Dark and Poison, that's my style. Like a back alley at midnight!
Kass.trainerLoses: The sun came up on me...

Kass.greeting: These wristbands are just for show. My Pokémon are for real!
Kass.trainerWins: The real deal, yo! Wristbands just make it look good.
Kass.trainerLoses: Guess the wristbands were all I had...

Scoop.greeting: Word on Route 17 says you've been winning a lot. Time to fix that!
Scoop.trainerWins: Word on Route 17 is: you lost!
Scoop.trainerLoses: Word's gonna spread... that I lost.

Scoop.greeting: My Sharpedo bites harder than the waves off Seafolk Village!
Scoop.trainerWins: Chomp! Told ya Sharpedo bites harder than the waves!

Scoop.greeting: I wore my best tank top up here. Don't make me sweat.

Dylan.greeting: My crew's got the loudest Pokémon in Alola! Exploud, crank it up!
Dylan.trainerWins: Loud and proud! They heard that all the way in Po Town!

Dylan.greeting: I skated all the way down Route 10 to get here. Ready to wipe out?
Dylan.trainerWins: You wiped out! Should've worn knee pads, kid.
Dylan.trainerLoses: I'm the one who wiped out...

Dylan.greeting: Spiritomb holds 108 spirits, and every one of 'em hates you already.
Dylan.trainerLoses: Even 108 spirits couldn't pull it off...

Evander.greeting: Toxapex and Weezing don't play nice. Neither do I.
I hang around the Malie City docks. Tough place, tougher Trainers.
Evander.trainerLoses: Guess I'm not that tough after all...

Evander.greeting: See the stripe on my shirt? Racing stripe. 'Cause I'm fast at winning.
Evander.trainerLoses: Racing stripe... more like losing stripe.

Myrna.greeting: Pink hair, bad attitude. Got a problem with that?
Myrna.trainerWins: Didn't think so! Pink hair stays undefeated.
Myrna.trainerLoses: Fine, I've got a problem now. It's you.

Myrna.greeting: Weezing and I came straight from the Po Town rain. We're soaked and cranky!
Myrna.trainerWins: Cranky wins! Weezing's in a better mood now. Kinda.
Myrna.trainerLoses: Now I'm soaked, cranky AND beaten.

Myrna.greeting: This is my lucky cap. Touch it and you lose.

Eva.greeting: Pink hair, black top, sharp teeth on my Sharpedo. All edge!
Eva.trainerWins: Sliced right through you! Told you I was all edge.
Eva.trainerLoses: Lost my edge... and Sharpedo lost its bite.

Eva.greeting: Scrafty taught me two things: pull your pants up, then throw down!
Eva.trainerWins: Scrafty style! Pants up, opponent down!

Eva.greeting: I hang out at the Hau'oli Marina scaring Wingull. You're next.
Eva.trainerWins: Shoo, shoo! Just like the Wingull!
Eva.trainerLoses: Even the Wingull are laughing at me.

Agrata.greeting: Rules are for Trainers' School kids. Up here, I make my own!
Agrata.trainerWins: My rules, my win! Write that down, Trainers' School kid.
Agrata.trainerLoses: Okay... maybe rules aren't so bad.

Agrata.greeting: Toxicroak's Poison Jab is a bad mood with a fist. Wanna try it?
Agrata.trainerWins: Jabbed! Toxicroak's bad mood is all yours now.

Agrata.greeting: My skirt's short, my temper's shorter. Let's go!
Agrata.trainerWins: Told you my temper was short! So was the battle.
Agrata.trainerLoses: My temper's gone. So is my win.

Abby.greeting: Exploud and I are gonna make enough noise to shake Poni Island!
Abby.trainerWins: Poni Island shook! Did you feel it? I felt it!

Abby.greeting: I painted my nails black for this battle. Like my mood.
Abby.trainerLoses: Chipped a nail. And my pride.

Abby.greeting: Absol shows up when disaster's coming. Guess who brought Absol?

Parker.greeting: See this bat? I hit homers at the Hau'oli ball field. Now I'm swinging for you!
Parker.trainerWins: Home run! That one's going over the Hau'oli outfield fence!

Parker.greeting: I ran laps around Iki Town this morning. Warmed up and ready!
Parker.trainerWins: Workout complete! Those Iki Town laps paid off!

Parker.greeting: Talonflame is the fastest pitcher I know! Fastball coming your way!
Parker.trainerWins: Fastball, strike three! Talonflame's got a cannon!
Parker.trainerLoses: You knocked it out of the park...

Isaac.greeting: Coach says the Iki Town team never quits. Batter up!
Hawlucha and I practice wrestling moves on the beach. Ready for the top rope?
This bat's signed by my whole team. It's my lucky charm!
Isaac.trainerLoses: Guess I need to get it signed again...

Ayden.greeting: Battling's like baseball: three outs and you're done. Let's play ball!
Ayden.trainerLoses: Three outs... I'm the one who's done.

Ayden.greeting: I run sprints on Big Wave Beach. Sand training makes me unstoppable!
Ayden.trainerWins: Unstoppable! All that sand training paid off!
Ayden.trainerLoses: Stopped cold, right in the sand...

Ayden.greeting: Pidgeot and Staraptor! My outfield is all fliers. Nothing gets past them!
Ayden.trainerWins: Caught it! Nothing gets past my outfield!
Ayden.trainerLoses: Dropped the ball... my outfielders are gonna hear about this.

Alwyn.greeting: My serve is the fastest on the Hau'oli tennis courts. Try to return it!
Alwyn.trainerWins: Ace! You never even touched that serve!

Alwyn.greeting: I sprint up the Route 2 hills before school every day. Keep up!
Blaziken kicks harder than I serve! Let's play!
Alwyn.trainerWins: Game, set, match! Blaziken kicks harder than any serve!

Mardea.greeting: Racket ready, shoes laced, Pokémon pumped. Let's play a set!
Mardea.trainerLoses: Lost the set... and the match. Rematch?

Mardea.greeting: I trained on the Akala courts in the afternoon heat. A battle is nothing!
Hawlucha and Staraptor are my doubles partners in the sky!
Mardea.trainerWins: Doubles champs! Hawlucha and Staraptor ruled the sky!

Gabriella.greeting: I play beach volleyball at Hano Beach. Ready for a spike?
Gabriella.trainerWins: Spiked it! Straight into the sand!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: You blocked every spike I sent...

Gabriella.greeting: My racket has brand-new strings. Let's test them on your team!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: Snapped a string... and my winning streak.

Gabriella.greeting: Tauros and Mudsdale are my workout buddies. We run Paniola Ranch every morning!
Gabriella.trainerWins: Ranch-tough! Those morning runs paid off!
Gabriella.trainerLoses: Back to the ranch to train...

Ryder.greeting: I raised the strongest starters from every region. Decidueye included!
I'm the next big thing in Alola. Lucky you, battling me before I'm famous!
Ryder.trainerWins: Remember this day! You'll be telling people about it someday.

Ryder.greeting: Top marks in starter care at the Trainers' School in Hau'oli!
Ryder.trainerWins: Top marks again! My Trainers' School teachers would be proud.

Christopher.greeting: I trained at the top of Mount Lanakila. My whole team is ice-cold!
Christopher.trainerWins: Frozen solid, just like the top of Lanakila!
Christopher.trainerLoses: Thawed out... Alola's too warm for me.

Christopher.greeting: Top of my class at the Trainers' School. Ice-types are my specialty.
Christopher.trainerWins: A+ in Ice-types! Top of the class again.

Christopher.greeting: Alola's hot, but my team is cold. Want some shave ice?
Christopher.trainerWins: Brain freeze! Want some shave ice to go with it?
Christopher.trainerLoses: Melted like shave ice in the sun...

Sorley.greeting: Politoed brings the rain, and my Water-types love it!
Sorley.trainerLoses: The rain stopped... and so did my luck.

Sorley.greeting: My mentor says I'm a rising star, like the tide at Kala'e Bay!
Sorley.trainerWins: High tide! I keep rising, just like Kala'e Bay!
Sorley.trainerLoses: Low tide for me... the bay's empty.

Sorley.greeting: Wishiwashi alone is tiny, but in a school it's huge. Just like my potential!

Beatrice.greeting: Primarina sings, Decidueye snipes, Incineroar wrestles. Alola's finest starters!
Beatrice.trainerLoses: Even Alola's finest have off days...

Beatrice.greeting: I've watched every match at the Battle Royal Dome. I know all the tricks!
Beatrice.trainerWins: Studied and solved! The Battle Royal Dome taught me well.
Beatrice.trainerLoses: You had tricks I've never seen!

Beatrice.greeting: My hair's up for battle! Down is for sunsets at Hano Beach.
Beatrice.trainerLoses: Hair's coming down... time for a sunset.

Brandi.greeting: Today's my Battle Tree debut! And my team's ice-cold.
Brandi.trainerWins: What a debut! I'll remember this one forever.

Brandi.greeting: Glaceon and Froslass! Frosty, right? Perfect for a hot Alolan day.
Brandi.trainerWins: Frostbitten! Glaceon and Froslass say hi.
Brandi.trainerLoses: My frost melted in the Alolan heat...

Brandi.greeting: I got snowed in on Lanakila once. Now my whole team is made of snow!
Brandi.trainerWins: Snowed you in! Just like Lanakila!
Brandi.trainerLoses: Avalanche... right on top of me.

Marsha.greeting: Everyone says I'm a rising star. Like the tide, I keep rising!
Marsha.trainerWins: Higher and higher! The tide keeps rising!

Marsha.greeting: Pelipper calls the rain, and my Water team rides the waves!
Marsha.trainerWins: Surf's up! Pelipper's rain made perfect waves!
Marsha.trainerLoses: Wiped out... not even the rain could save me.

Marsha.greeting: I grew up in Seafolk Village. Water is my home, and my team agrees!
Marsha.trainerWins: Seafolk pride! The sea always takes care of us!
Marsha.trainerLoses: The sea is calm, and so am I. Sad, but calm.

Cooper.greeting: I came to Alola for the sights, but this battle is the main attraction!
Cooper.trainerWins: Best attraction on the whole trip!
Cooper.trainerLoses: This attraction was a bit too thrilling for me...

Cooper.greeting: My Poké Finder is ready! Smile for your loss!
Cooper.trainerWins: Perfect shot! That one's going on the fridge.
Cooper.trainerLoses: Blurry photo... just like my strategy.

Cooper.greeting: Yellow shirt, orange cap... I dress like a sunset over Hano Beach!
Cooper.trainerLoses: The sun set on me, all right.

Darien.greeting: I've photographed every Totem Pokémon den on the islands. You're my next subject!
Darien.trainerLoses: Out of focus. Just like me today.

Darien.greeting: I ate my first Alolan malasada this morning. Now I'm on a sugar rush!
Darien.trainerWins: Sugar-rush victory! I need another malasada!
Darien.trainerLoses: And here comes the sugar crash...

Darien.greeting: My vacation itinerary says 'battle at the Battle Tree' right here. Check!
Darien.trainerLoses: Moving this one to next year's trip...

Hart.greeting: I'm visiting from Kalos! Alola's sun is so bright, I never take this cap off.
Hart.trainerWins: A bright win under a bright sun!
Hart.trainerLoses: The sun's in my eyes. Yeah, that's it.

Hart.greeting: Gyarados and Salamence make for great vacation photos. Scary ones.
Hart.trainerWins: Scary good photos AND a win!
Hart.trainerLoses: The scariest photo is the scoreboard...

Hart.greeting: I booked the Hano Grand Resort for a whole week. Plenty of time to win!
Hart.trainerWins: A vacation victory! Best week at the resort yet.
Hart.trainerLoses: Checking out of the resort early...

Kaula.greeting: This straw hat has shaded me on every beach in Alola. Today it shades a winner!
Kaula.trainerLoses: My hat blew away... along with my hopes.

Kaula.greeting: I bought a plumeria lei in Malie Garden. Smell that? That's victory!
Oricorio danced for me on Royal Avenue. My team loves to dance too!
Kaula.trainerWins: A dance of victory, just like Oricorio taught me!
Kaula.trainerLoses: We missed a step... Oricorio would be disappointed.

Charlene.greeting: I bought a guidebook just for this tree. Page twelve says I win!
Charlene.trainerLoses: I'd like a refund on this guidebook, please.

Charlene.greeting: This sundress is perfect for Alolan weather. Not so much for battles, but here we go!
A Decidueye stared right through me in the Lush Jungle once. Now it's mine!
Charlene.trainerLoses: Missed the mark... even Decidueye looks surprised.

Odessa.greeting: My cruise ship leaves Hau'oli at sunset, so let's make this quick!
Odessa.trainerWins: And I'll make it back to the ship in time!

Odessa.greeting: Arcanine and Salamence are my vacation bodyguards. Scary, aren't they?
This orange bag holds sunscreen, snacks and six Poké Balls. I'm ready!
Odessa.trainerWins: Packed for victory! Sunscreen, snacks and a win!

Jairo.greeting: I mop the Battle Tree lobby every morning. Let me mop up this battle too!
Jairo.trainerWins: All mopped up! The lobby AND the battle.
Jairo.trainerLoses: Looks like I'm the one who got mopped...

Jairo.greeting: Weezing and Toxapex keep the pipes clean. Kind of. Let's battle!
Jairo.trainerWins: Squeaky clean! The pipes and the battle.
Jairo.trainerLoses: Clogged up... I'll need a bigger plunger.

Jairo.greeting: These coveralls have seen every spill on Poni Island. Nothing fazes me!

Xaden.greeting: I sweep sand off the Battle Tree steps all day. My team brings it right back!
Xaden.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got swept away...

Xaden.greeting: Excadrill and Steelix dig holes faster than I can fill them. Let's see what they dig up!
Xaden.trainerWins: Struck gold! Excadrill and Steelix dug up a win!
Xaden.trainerLoses: Dug my own hole... and fell right in.

Xaden.greeting: Gray hair, blue coveralls, forty years on the job. Nobody outworks me.
Xaden.trainerWins: Forty years strong, and still outworking everyone!

Giles.greeting: I've seen a thousand battles from behind my broom. Now it's my turn!
Giles.trainerLoses: Back to my broom, I suppose.

Giles.greeting: Hippowdon kicks up Haina Desert sand, and I sweep it up after. Teamwork!
Giles.trainerLoses: Now I've got twice the sweeping to do...

Giles.greeting: Rock-solid team, rock-solid work ethic. Shall we?
Giles.trainerWins: Solid as ever! Hard work never lets me down.

Skip.greeting: Lunch break at the Malie construction site is short. Let's make this quick!
Hard hat on! My Ground and Electric crew strings power lines across Ula'ula!
Skip.trainerWins: Power on! The lines are humming all across Ula'ula!
Skip.trainerLoses: Blackout... the whole site's gone dark.

Skip.greeting: Alolan Golem is magnetic, perfect for lifting steel beams!
Skip.trainerWins: Lifted with ease! Golem's magnet never slips.
Skip.trainerLoses: Dropped the beam... on my foot.

JT.greeting: I work the ice plant up on Mount Lanakila. Every Pokémon I've got is Ice-type!
JT.trainerWins: Frozen solid, like the ice plant on a busy day!
JT.trainerLoses: Total meltdown... the ice plant's gonna hear about this.

JT.greeting: Hard hat, ice pick and an all-Ice team. Let's chill!
JT.trainerLoses: Thawed... my ice pick's gone dull.

JT.greeting: Alolan Ninetales makes it snow, then the rest of my crew gets to work!
JT.trainerWins: Snowed in! Ninetales did all the hard work.
JT.trainerLoses: The snow melted... and so did my crew.

Benjamin.greeting: Safety first! My Ice-types keep the Lanakila tunnels frozen solid.
Benjamin.trainerWins: No accidents, just a cold, clean win!
Benjamin.trainerLoses: Good thing I wore my hard hat. That hit hard.

Benjamin.greeting: Abomasnow calls the hail, and the whole crew gets to work!
Benjamin.trainerWins: Hailstorm success! The crew did great work today.
Benjamin.trainerLoses: The hail stopped... and so did my crew.

Benjamin.greeting: I carve ice sculptures for the Malie festival! Today I'm sculpting a win!

Henry.greeting: Even a gentleman wears an Alola shirt on Poni Island. Shall we battle with grace?
Henry.trainerWins: Graceful to the very end. Splendid.
Henry.trainerLoses: You battle with more grace than I. Bravo.

Henry.greeting: I summer at the Hano Grand Resort and winter in Malie. Battles are my year-round pleasure.
Henry.trainerLoses: Not so pleasant this time, I'm afraid.

Henry.greeting: Honchkrow and Toucannon: a refined aviary, if I may say so.
Henry.trainerWins: A splendid flight! My aviary soars.

Ikram.greeting: I left my Tapu Cocoa steaming on the lanai. Let's not let it cool, shall we?
Ikram.trainerLoses: My cocoa has gone cold. As have I.

Ikram.greeting: Sunshine, flame and flower. My team flourishes in the Alolan sun!
My beard is as white as Hano Beach sand. My Pokémon are hotter than it at noon!
Ikram.trainerWins: Scorching! Hotter than the Hano sand at noon!
Ikram.trainerLoses: Cooled right off, like the beach at sunset...

Jerry.greeting: Fine manners, fine Pokémon, fine floral shirt. A true gentleman has all three.
Jerry.trainerWins: And a fine victory to match.
Jerry.trainerLoses: Manners I have. Victory, it seems, I lack.

Jerry.greeting: Charizard and Venusaur in the summer sun. Classic, like me.
Jerry.trainerWins: Timeless! Classics never go out of style.

Jerry.greeting: I attended the luau in Iki Town last night. I'm still full of energy!
Jerry.trainerWins: Luau power! I may have to attend another.

Cheryl.greeting: Oh my, what a darling Trainer. Do you like my muumuu? It's from Konikoni City.
Cheryl.trainerWins: Darling, you lost! But you looked lovely doing it.
Cheryl.trainerLoses: Oh my... I'll wear a different dress next time.

Cheryl.greeting: My villa overlooks Hano Beach. I watch the sunset every evening with my Pokémon.
Cheryl.trainerLoses: The sunset will look sad tonight...

Cheryl.greeting: Primarina sings at all my parties. Today, she sings of your defeat!

Christy.greeting: Only the finest Water-types for me, darling. Pearls of the sea!
Christy.trainerLoses: Darling, that was dreadfully inelegant of me.

Christy.greeting: Politoed brings the rain to my garden. Then my team swims right through you!
I collect pearls from the Konikoni jewelers, darling. And victories.
Christy.trainerLoses: My pearls have lost their luster...

Verna.greeting: My jewels came from Konikoni City, but my Lapras came from the sea itself.
Verna.trainerWins: Majestic! Lapras outshines every jewel I own.
Verna.trainerLoses: Poor Lapras sank like a stone...

Verna.greeting: Rain on my lanai means Ludicolo dances. Shall we dance too?
Verna.trainerWins: A splendid dance! Ludicolo was magnificent.
Verna.trainerLoses: Rained out... even Ludicolo stopped dancing.

Verna.greeting: This dress has flowers, my team has waves. Darling, you're in for a storm.

Duncan.greeting: Fossils from Ten Carat Hill, rarities from every region. My collection is legendary!
Duncan.trainerWins: Another rare piece for the collection!
Duncan.trainerLoses: A loss... the one item I never wanted.

Duncan.greeting: Arms crossed means I'm confident. And I'm VERY confident.
Tyrantrum and Aurorus were revived from fossils. Ancient power, modern victory!
Duncan.trainerWins: Prehistoric power! These fossils still bite!
Duncan.trainerLoses: Extinct... back to the fossil display.

Nobunaga.greeting: My collection is complete, except for one thing: a win over you!
Nobunaga.trainerWins: Now my collection is truly complete!

Nobunaga.greeting: I traded for Kangaskhan and Tauros at the Festival Plaza. Rare finds!
Nobunaga.trainerWins: Rare and ready! Best trades I ever made.

Nobunaga.greeting: I keep my rarest Poké Balls in these pouches. Want to see what's inside?
Nobunaga.trainerWins: Surprise! Bet you didn't see that coming out of my pouches.

Arnon.greeting: Fore! This battle's going to be a hole in one!
Arnon.trainerWins: Hole in one, just like I called it!
Arnon.trainerLoses: Bogey... maybe even a double bogey.

Arnon.greeting: I play eighteen holes on Melemele every Sunday. My Grass-types love a good fairway!
Red visor, red polo... the sharpest dresser on the green!

Alim.greeting: Patience and precision: the secret to golf and to battling.
Alim.trainerWins: Right on target. Patience pays off.
Alim.trainerLoses: My precision was off today. You were spot-on.

Alim.greeting: My team grew up on the fairways of Akala. Grass-types love a well-kept lawn!
Alim.trainerLoses: Mowed down... like the Akala fairways.

Alim.greeting: The trade winds off Poni are tricky, but my swing adjusts!
Alim.trainerWins: Adjusted perfectly! The trade winds are on my side.

Zeno.greeting: All of my Pokémon evolved from Eevee! A different club for every shot!
Zeno.trainerLoses: Wrong club... I should've picked Vaporeon.

Zeno.greeting: Sylveon, Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon... my Eevee family never misses a putt!
Zeno.trainerWins: Sunk it! My Eevee family never misses!
Zeno.trainerLoses: Lipped out... even Sylveon couldn't sink that one.

Zeno.greeting: I usually play eighteen holes. This battle will be a quick nine.
Zeno.trainerLoses: Way over par... time to head to the clubhouse.

Anisa.greeting: My swing is perfect, and so is my team. Let's tee off!
Anisa.trainerLoses: I sliced it right into the rough...

Anisa.greeting: Grass-types make the best caddies. They know the fairway by heart!
Anisa.trainerWins: Fairway expertise! My caddies never get lost.

Anisa.greeting: I played a dawn round near Paniola Ranch. A Mudsdale kept stepping on my ball.
Anisa.trainerWins: Still made par! Even with a Mudsdale on the course!

Calliope.greeting: Three tournaments this season. Shall we make it four?
Calliope.trainerWins: Four for four! What a season!
Calliope.trainerLoses: Three out of four is still a good season.

Calliope.greeting: Lurantis and Decidueye are my favorite partners on the Akala greens!
Calliope.trainerLoses: Off the green and into the trees...

Calliope.greeting: My visor keeps the Alolan sun out of my eyes. I see the win clearly!

Christina.greeting: The wind is just right. Let's see where this battle lands!
Christina.trainerLoses: The wind must have shifted on me...

Christina.greeting: Eight Eeveelutions, one bag of clubs. Pick your poison!
Christina.trainerLoses: Wrong pick... I should've gone with Umbreon.

Christina.greeting: I named all my Eeveelutions after golf courses on Melemele!
Christina.trainerWins: Course record! Named after the best course on Melemele!
Christina.trainerLoses: Rain delay... and Vaporeon's the only one enjoying it.

Nedry.greeting: I raised every one of my Pokémon out at Paniola Ranch. Ranch-strong!
Nedry.trainerLoses: Back to the ranch for more training...

Nedry.greeting: Poké Beans for good behavior, lots of petting for good battling!
Nedry.trainerWins: Beans for everyone! Good behavior AND good battling!

Nedry.greeting: These overalls have pockets full of treats. My team knows it!
Nedry.trainerWins: Treat time! My team earned every one.

Sheridan.greeting: Love and good food make strong Pokémon. Let me show you!
Sheridan.trainerWins: Love and good food, that's the secret!
Sheridan.trainerLoses: I'd better feed them an extra treat tonight...

Sheridan.greeting: I tend my Pokémon on Poké Pelago every morning. They're bursting with energy!
Sheridan.trainerWins: Pelago power! Bursting with energy, like I said!
Sheridan.trainerLoses: Back to the Pelago for a rest...

Sheridan.greeting: My hat keeps the sun off, and my overalls keep the mud off. Let's go!
Sheridan.trainerLoses: Muddy and beaten... my overalls didn't help.

Kiernan.greeting: I raise Fire- and Grass-types under the Paniola sun. They grow up strong!
Kiernan.trainerWins: Sun-grown strength! The Paniola sun never fails.

Kiernan.greeting: Arcanine and Venusaur are my pride. Patience grows champions!
Kiernan.trainerWins: Patience, rewarded! Arcanine and Venusaur did me proud.
Kiernan.trainerLoses: I'll need a bit more patience...

Kiernan.greeting: I've got an Egg hatching in my overalls right now. Gotta win quick!
Kiernan.trainerWins: Hatched a win! And the Egg's still warm!
Kiernan.trainerLoses: Hatching a plan for next time...

Dara.greeting: My babies are all grown up now, and they're itching to battle!
Dara.trainerLoses: My poor babies... come here, let me hug you all.

Dara.greeting: I braid Mudsdale's mane every morning on the ranch. Today, braids for battle!
I feed my team Pinap Berries from my own garden. So ono!
Dara.trainerWins: An ono victory! The Pinap Berries worked!

Rada.greeting: I check every Pokémon's health each morning. They're in perfect shape!
Rada.trainerLoses: Time for an extra checkup, I think.

Rada.greeting: Mimikyu wears a costume, and I wear a cowboy hat. We're both dressed for success!
Rada.trainerLoses: Costume torn... Mimikyu's going to be upset.

Rada.greeting: Pikipek wakes me at sunrise on Route 5. The early bird wins!

Gertrude.greeting: I've bred Pokémon for years. Let's see if your team measures up.
Gertrude.trainerWins: Measured up and came up short. Keep training!
Gertrude.trainerLoses: Your team measures up just fine. More than fine.

Gertrude.greeting: Fire and grass, sun and soil. My Pokémon grow like crops in the Paniola sun!
Gertrude.trainerWins: A bumper crop! The Paniola sun never fails.
Gertrude.trainerLoses: Crop failure... the soil must be tired.

Gertrude.greeting: My braids are older than your Pokédex. So's my experience!
Gertrude.trainerWins: Experience wins! My braids have seen it all.

Dyson.greeting: Welcome to the Battle Tree! Allow me to check you in... to a loss!
Dyson.trainerWins: Thank you for your stay! Please come again!
Dyson.trainerLoses: I'm afraid I've been checked out...

Dyson.greeting: I work at the Hano Grand Resort. Hauling luggage makes Fighting-types strong!
Dyson.trainerLoses: Dropped the bags... and the battle.

Dyson.greeting: A bow for my guest! Now then, Bewear, Throh, Sawk... front desk, please!
Dyson.trainerWins: Service complete! Thank you for choosing the Battle Tree.
Dyson.trainerLoses: Room service is closed for the night...

Chip.greeting: I carry luggage all day. Carrying my team to victory is easy!
Chip.trainerLoses: Dropped the luggage... and the battle.

Chip.greeting: Bewear could carry every suitcase in the Tide Song Hotel! Ready?
Chip.trainerWins: Strong arms win! Bewear could carry you back down, too.

Chip.greeting: Uniform pressed, bow perfected, Pokémon throwing punches!
Chip.trainerWins: Perfect service, perfect bow, perfect win!

Zero.greeting: Service with a smile! But I won't go easy on you.
Zero.trainerWins: Still smiling! Service with a smile and a win.

Zero.greeting: I park cars at the Hano Grand Resort. Watch me park your whole team!
Zero.trainerWins: Parked! Right in the loser's spot.
Zero.trainerLoses: Towed away... and I didn't even get a ticket.

Zero.greeting: Gyarados and Salamence: the scariest room service in Alola!

Julien.greeting: Spicy malasadas are my specialty. Hope you can handle the heat!
Julien.trainerWins: Too spicy for you? I warned you!

Julien.greeting: Fire for grilling, Water for boiling, Ice for shave ice. My team is a full kitchen!
Julien.trainerWins: A five-star meal! The whole kitchen did its part.

Julien.greeting: Apron on, ladle ready! Let's get cooking!
Julien.trainerWins: Order up! Hot and fresh, just how I like it.
Julien.trainerLoses: Overcooked... and I left the ladle in the pot.

Sly.greeting: My secret ingredient? A pinch of pure battle spirit!
Sly.trainerLoses: I must have forgotten the secret ingredient...

Sly.greeting: I run a poke stand in Heahea City. Fresh fish, fresh strategies!
Sly.trainerLoses: Spoiled... the fish AND the strategy.

Sly.greeting: Turtonator keeps my stove hot, Froslass keeps my fridge cold. Perfect balance!
Sly.trainerWins: A balanced meal! Hot, cold and perfectly done.
Sly.trainerLoses: Unbalanced... the stove's too hot and the fridge's too cold.

Noah.greeting: Battles are like stew: the longer they simmer, the better they taste!
Noah.trainerLoses: Overcooked... this one's going in the trash.

Noah.greeting: I serve loco moco at the Pokémon Center café. Today's special: your defeat!
Noah.trainerWins: Served hot! Loco moco and a win, the café special.

Noah.greeting: My ladle is as old as my recipes. Both still pack plenty of flavor!
Noah.trainerWins: Flavorful! My old ladle still has it.

Brantley.greeting: I put out fires for a living. My Water-types are my hoses!
Brantley.trainerWins: Fire's out! My Water-types never let me down.
Brantley.trainerLoses: You put out my fire completely...

Brantley.greeting: Wela Volcano Park is my beat. If it can survive lava, it can survive you!
Brantley.trainerLoses: Melted... and I thought we could survive lava.

Brantley.greeting: Hands together for focus. Firefighters always stay calm!
Brantley.trainerWins: Calm and collected, like a true firefighter!

Camber.greeting: Training at the Heahea fire station keeps my team in top shape!
Camber.trainerLoses: Back to the station for more training.

Camber.greeting: Politoed makes it rain. The easiest fire I ever put out!
Camber.trainerWins: Rained out! Politoed did all the work.
Camber.trainerLoses: Drought... not a drop of rain in sight.

Camber.greeting: My uniform is fireproof. Is your team?
Camber.trainerWins: Doused! Your team wasn't fireproof after all.

Rendor.greeting: Halt! You're under arrest for having too long a winning streak!
Rendor.trainerWins: Case closed! You have the right to remain defeated.
Rendor.trainerLoses: You're free to go... I couldn't hold you.

Rendor.greeting: I patrol Hau'oli City from the marina to the shopping district. Nothing gets by me!
Rendor.trainerWins: Nothing gets by me! Not even you.
Rendor.trainerLoses: Well, you got by me. Carry on, citizen.

Rendor.greeting: My mustache is regulation length. My Pokémon are regulation strong!
Rendor.trainerWins: By the book, mustache and all!
Rendor.trainerLoses: Off the books... and my mustache is drooping.

Lou.greeting: A sandstorm on Route 13? That's my cue! My team loves the dust.
Lou.trainerWins: Dusted! The sandstorm sends its regards.
Lou.trainerLoses: Blown away in my own sandstorm...

Lou.greeting: I patrol the Haina Desert on Mudsdale-back. Ground-types are my partners!
Cap straight, badge shined. Ready to enforce some rules!
Lou.trainerWins: Rules enforced! Cap straight, badge shining.
Lou.trainerLoses: Rule broken: me. My badge has lost its shine.

Benji.greeting: Justice is swift, and so are my Pokémon in a sandstorm!
Benji.trainerLoses: Justice was a little slow today...

Benji.greeting: Tyranitar and Garchomp guard the Malie police station. Try to get past!
Benji.trainerWins: Nobody gets past the Malie station!

Benji.greeting: I salute every challenger. Then I arrest their streak.
Benji.trainerWins: Arrested! Your streak's going to jail.
Benji.trainerLoses: Released... your streak's free to go.

Cal.greeting: My hypothesis: my team defeats yours. Let's run the experiment!
I study Trick Room at the Dimensional Research Lab in Heahea. Slow is the new fast!
Cal.trainerWins: Dimensions twisted! Slow really is the new fast.

Cal.greeting: Lab coat buttoned, glasses polished. The experiment begins!

Tivon.greeting: I've calculated a 94.3% chance of victory. Shall we test it?
Tivon.trainerLoses: I must have misplaced a decimal point...

Tivon.greeting: Reuniclus and Slowking: the slower they are, the sooner they move in Trick Room!
Tivon.trainerWins: Paradox solved! Slower is faster, as calculated.
Tivon.trainerLoses: Paradox unsolved... my calculations are in shambles.

Tivon.greeting: I came straight from Hokulani Observatory. The stars predicted your defeat!

Robyn.greeting: Every battle is research. Let's collect some data, shall we?
Robyn.trainerLoses: This data will require further analysis... a lot of it.

Robyn.greeting: Bronzong and Cofagrigus are my lab assistants. Very heavy lab assistants.
My glasses help me spot every weakness on your team. Fogged up yet?
Robyn.trainerWins: Every weakness, spotted! These glasses never lie.
Robyn.trainerLoses: Glasses fogged... I didn't see that coming.

Chucky.greeting: Hiyah! I trained under Kahuna Hala in Iki Town!
Red headband, black belt, fighting spirit! Prepare yourself!
Chucky.trainerWins: Fighting spirit! The red headband never loses!
Chucky.trainerLoses: My spirit... broken. I'll tie my headband tighter.

Chucky.greeting: Hariyama and Medicham train with me on the Melemele shore. Every wave is a punch!
Chucky.trainerWins: A wave of punches! The Melemele shore taught me well!

Iniko.greeting: I train barefoot in the snow on Mount Lanakila! My spirit is unbreakable!
Ice and fists! Mamoswine, Beartic and my own two hands!
Iniko.trainerWins: Ice Punch! My hands and my team, frozen solid!
Iniko.trainerLoses: Thawed... my hands are cold for nothing.

Iniko.greeting: My headband's still wet from the Brooklet Hill waterfalls. Ready!
Iniko.trainerWins: Waterfall strength! Brooklet Hill never fails me!
Iniko.trainerLoses: Swept away... like a leaf in the waterfall.

Arnold.greeting: Training in a gi in the snow keeps me tough. My Ice-types keep me company!
Arnold.trainerWins: Cold discipline! My gi and my Ice-types held strong!
Arnold.trainerLoses: A cold loss... even colder than Lanakila.

Arnold.greeting: I break boards on Big Wave Beach every morning. Today, I break your streak!
Arnold.trainerWins: Broken! Your streak, like a board on Big Wave Beach!

Carrie.greeting: Let's dance! My Pokémon sway like hula at the Iki Town festival!
Carrie.trainerLoses: I missed a step... I lost the rhythm.

Carrie.greeting: Oricorio taught me every dance style on the islands. Which one will beat you?
Carrie.trainerWins: That one! The Pom-Pom style never misses!

Carrie.greeting: My flower crown is fresh from Malie Garden. Smell that sweet victory!
Carrie.trainerWins: Sweet! My crown smells like victory!

Variel.greeting: Hula tells stories! Today's story is a Rain Dance that washes you away!
Variel.trainerWins: What a beautiful story we told!
Variel.trainerLoses: This story didn't end the way I choreographed it.

Variel.greeting: Politoed and Pelipper call the rain, and my Water-types dance right through it!
Variel.trainerWins: Rain dance! My Water-types never miss a step!

Variel.greeting: My teal dress flows like the waves of Kala'e Bay!
Variel.trainerWins: A flowing victory, like the waves of Kala'e Bay!
Variel.trainerLoses: The wave crashed... right on my dress.

Atalanta.greeting: Feel the beat! My team never misses a step, especially in the rain!
Atalanta.trainerLoses: Off beat... the rain threw off our rhythm.

Atalanta.greeting: Ludicolo and I dance at every luau in Heahea City! Hana hou!
Kingdra and Swampert love a downpour. Let's make it rain!
Atalanta.trainerLoses: Just a drizzle... my downpour never came.

Harvey.greeting: The Aether Foundation protects Pokémon. But we battle hard, too!
Harvey.trainerWins: Protecting and winning: that's the Aether way!
Harvey.trainerLoses: Your Pokémon are clearly well cared for. Well done.

Harvey.greeting: My all-white uniform stays spotless, even in battle. Aether standards!
Harvey.trainerLoses: Stained... Aether's laundry service will be busy.

Harvey.greeting: I rescued these Pokémon from the Po Town rain. They're stronger than ever now!
Harvey.trainerLoses: Back to Aether Paradise to rest...

Luke.greeting: I care for injured Pokémon at Aether Paradise. My team is healthy and strong!
Luke.trainerLoses: Maybe they need a rest back at Aether Paradise.

Luke.greeting: White from head to toe. Aether Paradise style!
Luke.trainerWins: Paradise-perfect! Not a speck on me.
Luke.trainerLoses: Paradise lost... and my uniform's a mess.

Luke.greeting: Turtonator and Bruxish were rescued from Alola's shores. Now they protect me!
Luke.trainerWins: Protected! Turtonator and Bruxish repay the favor!

Granville.greeting: I've beaten every Trial Captain in Alola. You're next!
Granville.trainerLoses: You're tougher than any Trial Captain I've faced.

Granville.greeting: Speed is everything. Talonflame and Weavile move before you can blink!
Granville.trainerWins: Too fast! You blinked, and it was over.
Granville.trainerLoses: Out-sped... I blinked, and it was over.

Granville.greeting: Spiky hair, sharp mind. Let's go!
Granville.trainerWins: Sharp as ever! Hair and mind!

Raz.greeting: Strategy beats strength. Let me show you why.
Raz.trainerLoses: Your strategy was a step ahead of mine.

Raz.greeting: Crobat, Jolteon, Aerodactyl. Strike first, strike hard!
Raz.trainerLoses: Struck back... first isn't always best.

Raz.greeting: I finished the island challenge in record time. I'm fast at everything!
Raz.trainerLoses: Slowed down... my record's in danger.

Heidi.greeting: The Aether Foundation preserves habitats. Let's preserve my streak, too!
Heidi.trainerLoses: Looks like my streak is now an endangered species...

Heidi.greeting: I track wild Pokémon across all four islands for Aether. You're a rare sighting!
My white uniform reflects the sun at Aether Paradise. Bright, isn't it?
Heidi.trainerWins: Dazzling! The Aether sun shines on me.
Heidi.trainerLoses: Dimmed... even Aether Paradise feels gloomy.

Haley.greeting: I study Pokémon ecology at Aether Paradise. I know exactly how yours behave!
Haley.trainerLoses: Your Pokémon behaved in ways my studies never covered!

Haley.greeting: Comfey and Ribombee come from Melemele's meadows. Rescued and thriving!
Haley.trainerWins: Thriving! Comfey and Ribombee are in full bloom!
Haley.trainerLoses: Wilting... Comfey and Ribombee need a rest.

Haley.greeting: White cap, white coat, white boots. Even my tablet is white!
Haley.trainerWins: A pure victory! White as my uniform.

Lea.greeting: I don't battle for fun. I battle to win.
Lea.trainerWins: As I said, I battle to win.
Lea.trainerLoses: I came to win... maybe I should learn to have fun too.

Lea.greeting: The sun's out on Poni Island. Fire and Grass are ready to bloom and burn!
Lea.trainerWins: Bloom and burn! The Poni sun is on my side.
Lea.trainerLoses: Clouded over... no sun, no win.

Lea.greeting: My visor keeps my eyes on the prize. That's you.
Lea.trainerLoses: Prize lost... my visor didn't help.

Sylvia.greeting: I've analyzed every type matchup there is. You can't surprise me!
Ninetales calls the sun, Exeggutor stands tall. Classic Alola!
Sylvia.trainerWins: Classic Alola! Sun up, Exeggutor tall!
Sylvia.trainerLoses: Cut down... even Exeggutor isn't tall enough today.

Sylvia.greeting: Pointing is rude, but I'm pointing at the winner: me!

Stein.greeting: My latest invention is a team optimized for this exact battle!
Stein.trainerLoses: Back to the lab for some adjustments...

Stein.greeting: Cresselia and Slowbro: one dreams, one forgets. Perfect test subjects!
Stein.trainerWins: Perfect results! One dreamed of winning, the other forgot to lose.

Stein.greeting: I've read Aether Paradise's research. Your team's stats are already in my notes.
Stein.trainerWins: Exactly as noted! My research is flawless.

Cadel.greeting: Science explains everything, especially why I'm about to win!
Cadel.trainerLoses: Science cannot explain how you did that...

Cadel.greeting: Dusknoir and Jellicent in Trick Room. Slow, spooky and scientific!
Cadel.trainerWins: Spooky science! Trick Room never fails.
Cadel.trainerLoses: Science, scared... Dusknoir's hiding behind me.

Cadel.greeting: Lab coat, tie, clipboard. I'm dressed for a breakthrough!
Cadel.trainerWins: Breakthrough! I'll publish this right away.
Cadel.trainerLoses: Breakdown... my clipboard's flying off the tree.

Boris.greeting: Ten thousand punches a day! Can you withstand them all?
Boris.trainerLoses: I should try twenty thousand tomorrow...

Boris.greeting: Blaziken and Infernape: kicks of fire, fists of flame!
Boris.trainerWins: Fiery fists! Blaziken and Infernape never miss!
Boris.trainerLoses: Burned out... my fists need a rest.

Boris.greeting: I train on the ridge at Wela Volcano Park. Heat forges discipline!
Boris.trainerWins: Forged in fire! Wela's heat made us unbreakable!

Bryson.greeting: I meditated on Mount Lanakila for a week. My mind is clear!
Bryson.trainerWins: A clear mind leads to victory!
Bryson.trainerLoses: My mind is cloudy now... I must meditate again.

Bryson.greeting: Swampert and Feraligatr train with me in the Melemele Sea. Water builds strength!
Bryson.trainerWins: Tidal power! The Melemele Sea made us strong!

Bryson.greeting: Barefoot, belted, bowing. And then I strike!

Jo.greeting: I've danced on every stage in Alola. This is my grandest yet!
Jo.trainerWins: A standing ovation for my team!

Jo.greeting: Dragonite, Salamence, Garchomp... my backup dancers are dragons!
Jo.trainerWins: Dragon Dance! My backup dancers stole the show!

Jo.greeting: My flower crown came from Akala's meadows. Every petal is a dance step!
Jo.trainerLoses: Petals scattered... my crown's falling apart.

Tasanee.greeting: Let's put on a show! The crowd deserves something spectacular!
Tasanee.trainerLoses: The show's over... and you stole it.

Tasanee.greeting: Milotic and Lapras glide like hula dancers on the water. Watch!
Tasanee.trainerWins: Graceful! Milotic and Lapras never miss a step!
Tasanee.trainerLoses: Sank... my water dancers lost their footing.

Tasanee.greeting: I perform at the Hano Grand Resort luau every night. Tonight, I perform for you!
Tasanee.trainerWins: Bravo! The luau crowd would be on their feet!

Levi.greeting: I've climbed this tree more times than I can count. You won't stop me.
Levi.trainerWins: Like I said, no one stops me.
Levi.trainerLoses: I'll have to start counting from zero again.

Levi.greeting: I trained my Fire-types in Wela Volcano Park. Feel the heat!
Levi.trainerWins: Too hot to handle! Wela Volcano training pays off!

Levi.greeting: My gloves are fireproof for a reason. Charizard gets excited!
Levi.trainerLoses: Burned out... even my fireproof gloves are smoking.

Hashim.greeting: Elite Trainers don't make mistakes. Let's begin.
Hashim.trainerLoses: One mistake... that's all it took.

Hashim.greeting: Kommo-o and Golisopod: armor from Alola's mountains and seas!
Hashim.trainerWins: Armor holds! Mountain and sea, unbroken!
Hashim.trainerLoses: Armor cracked... Kommo-o and Golisopod need repairs.

Hashim.greeting: This jacket has seen Vast Poni Canyon and Exeggutor Island. I've seen everything.
Hashim.trainerWins: Seen it all, and won it all!

Munin.greeting: I've been watching your battles. I know exactly what you'll do next.
Munin.trainerLoses: I didn't see that coming at all...

Munin.greeting: Vikavolt, Decidueye, Goodra... I caught the toughest Pokémon in Alola's jungles!
Munin.trainerWins: Jungle tough! The Lush Jungle raised them right!

Munin.greeting: Gloves on, focus sharp. Let's settle this.
Munin.trainerLoses: Unsettled... I didn't see that one coming.

Poppy.greeting: Every battle is a chance to grow. Let's both get stronger today!
Poppy.trainerWins: I grew a little today. Did you?
Poppy.trainerLoses: You helped me grow a lot today. Thank you!

Poppy.greeting: Honchkrow and Mandibuzz circle the Poni Wilds at dusk. Ominous, right?
Poppy.trainerWins: Swooped! Honchkrow and Mandibuzz never miss.
Poppy.trainerLoses: Grounded... even my fliers came down.

Poppy.greeting: Light-blue visor, dark team. I like contrast!

Tamah.greeting: I've trained day and night to reach this height. I won't fall now!
Tamah.trainerLoses: I've fallen... but I'll climb right back up.

Tamah.greeting: Snorlax, Blissey and Slaking. Heavyweights, all of them!
Tamah.trainerLoses: Knocked out... and Snorlax wasn't even asleep.

Tamah.greeting: I jog to the Battle Tree from Seafolk Village every morning. Endurance is everything!
Tamah.trainerWins: Endurance wins! Those Seafolk jogs pay off!
Tamah.trainerLoses: Out of breath... I'll jog twice tomorrow.

Bette.greeting: My team is built for one thing only: crushing win streaks.
Gengar, Crobat, Nidoking... poison runs through my team like lava under Wela!

Bette.trainerLoses: Blunted... my visor's not so sharp today.

Kikujiro.greeting: Every Pokémon I've got is Electric-type. Forty years of lightning, kid!
Kikujiro.trainerWins: Shocking, isn't it? Forty years of lightning!
Kikujiro.trainerLoses: Grounded... forty years of lightning, and I'm grounded.

Kikujiro.greeting: Zapdos, Raikou, Thundurus. I chased storms across the world to catch them!
This jacket has watched lightning strike Mount Hokulani. Twice.
Kikujiro.trainerWins: Third strike! Hokulani's got nothing on me.
Kikujiro.trainerLoses: Struck down... like lightning on Hokulani.

Xenophon.greeting: Decades of battles have taught me one thing: never underestimate anyone.
Xenophon.trainerWins: I didn't underestimate you, and that's why I won.
Xenophon.trainerLoses: And still I underestimated you. Remarkable.

Xenophon.greeting: Tsareena, Virizion, Alolan Exeggutor... my garden fights back!
Xenophon.trainerWins: The garden grows! Nothing beats Alolan soil.
Xenophon.trainerLoses: Weeded out... my garden needs tending.

Xenophon.greeting: My hair hangs long like jungle vines. My team comes from the Lush Jungle, too.
Xenophon.trainerWins: Jungle law! The vines always win.

Placido.greeting: My Pokémon and I have grown old together. We still have plenty of fight left!
Placido.trainerLoses: Perhaps our fight is winding down after all...

Placido.greeting: Legends from every corner of the world. I've earned each one!
Articuno, Moltres... I've traveled far in this jacket. Farther than you'd think.
Placido.trainerLoses: A long way home in this old jacket...

Ignacio.greeting: I've traveled every region. Alola's Trainers are the toughest yet. Show me why.
Ignacio.trainerWins: Not quite the toughest yet. Keep at it.
Ignacio.trainerLoses: Yes, the toughest yet. You've proven it.

Ignacio.greeting: Latias and Latios carried me across the sea to Poni Island. They're ready.
Ignacio.trainerWins: Soaring! Latias and Latios carry me to victory.

Ignacio.greeting: My beard went gray from a lifetime of battles. One more won't hurt.
Ignacio.trainerWins: Still kicking! The gray beard's got some fight left!

Aino.greeting: Experience is my greatest weapon. Do you have enough to match it?
Aino.trainerLoses: You have experience beyond your years.

Aino.greeting: Gardevoir and Gallade read your moves before you make them. Psychic power!
Aino.trainerWins: Read like a book! Psychic power never lies.
Aino.trainerLoses: Unreadable... even Gardevoir couldn't read you.

Aino.greeting: I meditate at the Ruins of Life on Akala. Tapu Lele's power is with me!
Aino.trainerWins: Blessed! Tapu Lele smiles on me today.

Xio.greeting: I've seen countless Trainers rise and fall. Which will you be?
Xio.trainerWins: Fallen, I'm afraid. But you can rise again.
Xio.trainerLoses: You're rising. I can see it clearly now.

Xio.greeting: Every Pokémon I have is Fairy-type. Don't let the sparkles fool you!
Mimikyu, Togekiss and Primarina. Fairy tales come true at the Battle Tree!
Xio.trainerWins: Happily ever after! Fairy tales do come true.
Xio.trainerLoses: A sad ending... not every fairy tale ends happily.

Priya.greeting: In my day, we battled with heart. Let's see yours.
Priya.trainerWins: Your heart is strong, but not yet strong enough.
Priya.trainerLoses: Now that's a heart worth seeing.

Priya.greeting: Suicune and Raikou roamed free until they met me. Now they roam with me!
Priya.trainerLoses: They ran away... back to roaming.

Priya.greeting: Short hair, sturdy gloves, legendary team. I'm practical.

Candy.greeting: My Pokémon are seasoned like a fine dish. Ready for a taste?
Candy.trainerLoses: It seems your seasoning was even better.

Candy.greeting: The Swords of Justice answer to me. Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion, ready!
Candy.trainerLoses: Unjust... the Swords have been sheathed.

Candy.greeting: I've hiked Lanakila in these boots and gloves. A battle won't wear them out!
Candy.trainerWins: Durable! My boots and my team, still standing.
Candy.trainerLoses: Worn out... even these boots have their limits.

Napoleon.greeting: Laugh at my shorts all you want. My team is full of legendary Pokémon!
Napoleon.trainerWins: Not so funny now, huh? Legends don't lose!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: Even legends lose to the right Trainer... I guess that's you.

Napoleon.greeting: I may be small, but I plan battles like a general. And my soldiers are legends!
Napoleon.trainerWins: Victory, exactly as the general planned!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: Retreat! My grand strategy needs a rethink...

Napoleon.greeting: I saw Tapu Koko at the Ruins of Conflict once. I've been chasing legends ever since!
Napoleon.trainerWins: Tapu Koko would be proud of me!
Napoleon.trainerLoses: Guess I've still got a lot of chasing to do...

Brady.greeting: A kid in board shorts with a team of legends. Pretty cool, huh?
Brady.trainerWins: Kid in shorts: one. You: zero!
Brady.trainerLoses: Okay, the kid in shorts is going home now...

Brady.greeting: Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf: knowledge, emotion and willpower. I've got all three!
Brady.trainerLoses: Guess my knowledge wasn't enough this time.

Brady.greeting: Regigigas starts slow, just like me in the morning. But once we get going, look out!
Brady.trainerWins: Told you! Once we get going, nobody stops us!
Brady.trainerLoses: We never got going... back to bed for us.

Samantha.greeting: My flower clip says sweet. My team of legendary Pokémon says otherwise!
Samantha.trainerLoses: Even my legends couldn't save me...

Samantha.greeting: Raikou, Suicune, Zapdos... every legend I meet ends up joining my team!
Samantha.trainerWins: Another win for the legendary squad!
Samantha.trainerLoses: Maybe those legends should've joined you instead.

Samantha.greeting: I'm the toughest Lass on all four islands. My Regigigas agrees!

Inez.greeting: Everyone thinks a Lass in a skirt is easy. My legends would like a word!
Inez.trainerWins: Underestimated again. Thanks for the win!
Inez.trainerLoses: This time I'm the one who underestimated you.

Inez.greeting: I've chased legends from Lanakila's peak to the Poni coast. Ready to meet them?
Inez.trainerWins: Worth every step of the chase!
Inez.trainerLoses: Back to chasing. I need a stronger legend.

Inez.greeting: Latias and Latios are twins, just like me and my sister. We never lose!
Inez.trainerWins: Twin power wins! Wait till my sister hears!
Inez.trainerLoses: Please don't tell my twin about this...

Niara.greeting: I have starter Pokémon from every region! All grown up, just like me!
Niara.trainerWins: Starters are the best Pokémon ever!
Niara.trainerLoses: My starters need more training... and so do I.

Niara.greeting: When I'm eleven, I'm doing the island challenge! This is practice!
Niara.trainerLoses: Maybe I'll wait a few more years...

Niara.greeting: Professor Kukui let me hold a Poké Ball once! I'm basically a professor now!
Niara.trainerLoses: Professor Niara needs to study more...

Victor.greeting: My name means 'winner'! And my Pokémon are dragons! Rawr!
Victor.trainerWins: Rawr! Winner, just like my name!

Victor.greeting: My sun hat is white like Latios! That makes me super fast too!
Victor.trainerLoses: Not fast enough... my hat flew off.

Victor.greeting: I'm little, but my Dragonite is SO big. Big Dragonite hugs win battles!

Reina.greeting: My best friends are Primarina, Decidueye and Incineroar! Starters forever!
Reina.trainerLoses: We lose together and get stronger together!

Reina.greeting: I'm gonna be the first Alola League Champion from my preschool!
Reina.trainerLoses: Champions practice even when they lose!

Reina.greeting: I have starters from Kanto, Johto, Hoenn... I can't count that high yet!
Reina.trainerWins: One, two, three... that's how many I beat!
Reina.trainerLoses: I need to learn to count higher. And battle better.

Naya.greeting: Dragons are the coolest! I wanna ride one over Poni Island someday!
Cresselia gives me good dreams. Last night I dreamed I won!
Naya.trainerWins: My dream came true! Cresselia, you're the best!
Naya.trainerLoses: Maybe it was a different dream...

Naya.greeting: Garchomp is SO fast. Faster than a Tauros at Paniola Ranch!
Naya.trainerLoses: Garchomp, we got left in the dust!

Gwenny.greeting: I've backpacked across every region chasing legends. Look who came along!
Gwenny.trainerWins: The legends and I keep on trekking!
Gwenny.trainerLoses: Guess my trek isn't over yet.

Gwenny.greeting: Heatran keeps my tent warm on Lanakila. Handy, right? It's terrifying in battle, too.
Gwenny.trainerLoses: Even Heatran couldn't warm up this loss.

Gwenny.greeting: My backpack's full of trail mix and Poké Balls. The Poké Balls hold legends.
Gwenny.trainerLoses: I'll just eat my trail mix sadly...

Fernanda.greeting: I camp under the stars on the Poni Plains. My legendary Pokémon keep watch!
Fernanda.trainerLoses: No sleep tonight. Just thinking about that loss.

Fernanda.greeting: Tornadus and Landorus crossed the sea with me. Wind and earth, at your service!
Thumbs up! My boots have walked from the Haina Desert to Seafolk Village!
Fernanda.trainerLoses: My boots need a rest. So do I.

Vivek.greeting: Forty years of hiking Poni's trails. This tree is just another trail to me!
Vivek.trainerLoses: This trail sent me tumbling down a cliff...

Vivek.greeting: Gigalith and Shuckle are as hard as the stones of Ten Carat Hill!
See this pack? It's full of rocks, for training. My Pokémon carry even more!
Vivek.trainerLoses: Time to add more rocks to my pack.

Stellan.greeting: I've survived Lanakila blizzards in a tank top. A little battle won't faze me!
Stellan.trainerWins: Not even a chill! Still comfy in my tank top.

Stellan.greeting: Hippowdon and Tyranitar keep the sand swirling. Hope you brought goggles!
Stellan.trainerLoses: My sandstorm blew right past you.

Stellan.greeting: My boots are worn from the Ancient Poni Path. They'll carry me through this too!

Savir.greeting: Three promotions this year. You're my next big project, and I deliver results.
Savir.trainerLoses: This project needs a total restructure.

Savir.greeting: I keep a Poké Ball in my shirt pocket next to my pen. Both are always ready.
Savir.trainerLoses: My pen's out of ink. My team's out of steam.

Savir.greeting: Scizor, Excadrill and Steelix: a steel portfolio with zero risk!

Harding.greeting: I fly to Konikoni City for deals every week. This battle is my easiest contract yet.
Harding.trainerWins: Contract signed, sealed and delivered. Pleasure doing business.

Harding.greeting: Tie straight, shoes polished, Pokémon trained. Professionalism wins.
Harding.trainerLoses: Unprofessional of me to lose like that.

Harding.greeting: Bronzong and Bisharp: steel nerves for steel deals. Shall we?

Darrel.greeting: I manage fifty people at the Malie City office. Six Pokémon? Easy!
Darrel.trainerLoses: I'll need to call a team meeting about this...

Darrel.greeting: Florges and Aromatisse make my whole floor smell like a garden. Breathe it in!
I keep my hair short so it never gets in the way of a good battle!
Darrel.trainerLoses: Something got in my way: you.

Jana.greeting: My calendar is full, but I always pencil in a battle on Poni Island!
Jana.trainerWins: Time well spent! Penciling in another battle for next week.
Jana.trainerLoses: Should've spent that time at the office...

Jana.greeting: I did my shopping at the Thrifty Megamart on Royal Avenue. Last item on my list: a win!
Jana.trainerLoses: Out of stock on wins today...

Jana.greeting: Ludicolo dances on my desk when deadlines get close. Want to see it dance?

Etta.greeting: My Pokémon glare so hard, your team will shake before the first move!
Etta.trainerWins: Scared you stiff! Didn't even need the first move.

Etta.greeting: I've beaten every punk on Ula'ula Island. You're just small fry!
Gyarados, Salamence, Arcanine... one look and you'll wanna run!
Etta.trainerWins: Shoulda run when you had the chance!

Dustin.greeting: Respect's earned on Ula'ula, kid. My crew stares down Gyarados for fun.
Dustin.trainerWins: Stared you down! Ula'ula respect stays with my crew.

Dustin.greeting: Incineroar and Scrafty: heels with attitude, just like me.
Dustin.trainerWins: Heel turn complete! The crowd goes wild... or boos. Same thing.

Dustin.greeting: Tank top, shorts, no fear. That's how we roll in Po Town.
Dustin.trainerWins: No fear, all win! That's the Po Town way.
Dustin.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe a little fear now.

Zed.greeting: I ran Route 15's back alleys for years. This tree's my new turf!
Zed.trainerWins: My turf, my rules! Route 15 would be proud.
Zed.trainerLoses: Fine. Take the turf. I'll find another.

Zed.greeting: Alolan Muk eats garbage and spits venom. Kinda like my comebacks.
Pink hair, don't care! Let's make this loud!

Edda.greeting: Think you're tough? I've got scars from battles tougher than you.
Edda.trainerWins: Not even a scratch this time.
Edda.trainerLoses: Guess I'll be adding another scar...

Edda.greeting: Gengar and I hang out in the abandoned Megamart. Nothing scares us.
Edda.trainerWins: Spooked ya! Gengar's been practicing in the Megamart.

Edda.greeting: Black top, white cap, poison team. Everything about me says 'stay back'!

Leena.greeting: Speed is everything! My team's faster than a Sharpedo jet ride!
Leena.trainerWins: Too fast for you! Faster than any Sharpedo jet ride!
Leena.trainerLoses: You were faster... and that never happens.

Leena.greeting: I'm training for the big island games. You're my last warm-up!
Leena.trainerLoses: Guess I'm not ready for the games yet...

Leena.greeting: Weavile, Crobat, Talonflame... hitting first is my whole strategy!
Leena.trainerWins: First hit wins! Speed is everything!

Buddy.greeting: Coach says I'm the toughest on the team. And the fastest!
Buddy.trainerLoses: Coach is gonna make me run extra laps...

Buddy.greeting: Aerodactyl flies faster than a Charizard Glide over Poni! Catch us if you can!
Buddy.trainerWins: Couldn't catch us! Aerodactyl's still the fastest flier!
Buddy.trainerLoses: You caught us... Aerodactyl's gonna sulk all day.

Buddy.greeting: I swing this bat a hundred times every morning in Hau'oli. Batter up!
Buddy.trainerWins: Grand slam! Bases loaded, battle over!
Buddy.trainerLoses: The bat's cracked. So am I.

Hilario.greeting: I never skip leg day, and my team never skips speed training!
Hilario.trainerWins: Leg day pays off! Never skip it!
Hilario.trainerLoses: Maybe my Pokémon need a leg day too.

Hilario.greeting: Lycanroc and I race the sunset on Route 1. We haven't lost yet!
Hilario.trainerWins: Still undefeated! The sunset can't catch us!

Hilario.greeting: My serve and my team are both lightning fast. Raikou fast!
Hilario.trainerWins: Lightning ace! Raikou fast, like I said!

Thamina.greeting: I swim out to the Melemele Sea buoys every morning. My team swims even faster!
Thamina.trainerLoses: Out-swum... and I thought I was fast in the water.

Thamina.greeting: Greninja and Starmie are my relay team. Pass the baton!
Thamina.trainerWins: New relay record! Greninja and Starmie, perfect handoff!

Thamina.greeting: Tennis racket in hand, Pokémon at my side. Let's rally!
Thamina.trainerWins: Won the rally! You couldn't return a single shot!
Thamina.trainerLoses: Lost the rally... you hit back every time.

Dolly.greeting: My fans love it when it rains! Kingdra and Ludicolo get so fast!
Dolly.trainerLoses: Sorry, fans... I'll make it up to you.

Dolly.greeting: Suicune runs across water, and I run across stages! Showtime!
Dolly.trainerWins: Standing ovation! Suicune and I take a bow!

Dolly.greeting: Green shirt, big smile. I'm the star of Malie City!
Dolly.trainerWins: The star of Malie shines on!

Erix.greeting: A prodigy since age six! My team loves sunshine: fire and leaf!
Erix.trainerWins: Prodigy confirmed! Sunshine never fails me.

Erix.greeting: Ninetales turns up the sun, then Venusaur and Charizard turn up the heat!
Erix.trainerWins: A sunny victory! Not a cloud in the sky!
Erix.trainerLoses: Cloudy, with a chance of losing...

Erix.greeting: I trained on Exeggutor Island. Exeggutor and I both grew tall there!
Erix.trainerWins: Standing tall, just like Alolan Exeggutor!
Erix.trainerLoses: Cut down to size... even Exeggutor would be embarrassed.

Joaquin.greeting: My star's rising faster than the rain clouds over Malie!
Joaquin.trainerWins: Still rising! Malie's clouds can't keep up!
Joaquin.trainerLoses: You're rising even faster than me...

Joaquin.greeting: Swampert, Kingdra, Ludicolo. In the rain, nothing can catch them!
Joaquin.trainerWins: Rain dance! Swampert, Kingdra and Ludicolo, too fast!

Joaquin.greeting: I braid my hair before every battle for luck. Today it's extra tight!

Marianne.greeting: Youngest Battle Legend ever. Starting now!
Marianne.trainerLoses: Legends need patience. I'll get there.

Marianne.greeting: Moltres and Heatran! When the sun's out, my team burns like Wela Volcano!
Marianne.trainerWins: Volcanic! Wela Volcano would be jealous!

Marianne.greeting: Lilligant and Leafeon love the sunlight in Malie Garden. So do I!
Marianne.trainerWins: Blooming victory! Just like Malie Garden in spring!

Alice.greeting: I watched Wela Volcano smolder from up close. My team's raw power is even bigger!
Alice.trainerWins: Eruption! Told you my team's power was bigger!
Alice.trainerLoses: My power fizzled out like old lava...

Alice.greeting: Regigigas, Slaking, Archeops... slow starters, but huge finishers!
Alice.trainerWins: What a huge finish! Worth the slow start!

Alice.greeting: Camera charged, cap on, and my sightseeing day ends with a win!
Alice.trainerLoses: Not the ending I planned for my trip...

Chen.greeting: I always battle the best Trainer wherever I travel. That's you, isn't it?
Chen.trainerWins: Maybe I should look for the best Trainer somewhere else...
Chen.trainerLoses: Yes, definitely the best one here. What a trip!

Chen.greeting: Rampardos and Rhyperior hit harder than the surf on Big Wave Beach!
Chen.trainerWins: Wipeout! Bigger than any wave at Big Wave Beach!
Chen.trainerLoses: I'm the one who got wiped out...

Chen.greeting: Snap! I photograph my Pokémon before every battle. They look strong today!
Chen.trainerLoses: A photo of a loss. I'll crop that out.

Christian.greeting: The view from Poni's cliffs is gorgeous, but my team's special attacks are prettier!
Christian.trainerLoses: The view's still lovely, at least.

Christian.greeting: Chandelure and Volcarona light up the night like Hokulani Observatory!
Christian.trainerWins: A starry victory! Brighter than the Observatory!

Christian.greeting: My sun hat's wide enough to shade my whole team. Not that they need it!
Christian.trainerWins: Cool in the shade, hot in battle!

Ezra.greeting: I travel the islands to battle strong Trainers. Please be strong!
Ezra.trainerWins: Not quite strong enough... the search goes on.
Ezra.trainerLoses: Yes! You're exactly the strong Trainer I was looking for!

Ezra.greeting: Alakazam and Espeon can read minds. They already know I'm going to win.
Ezra.trainerWins: Called it! Alakazam and Espeon knew all along.
Ezra.trainerLoses: They read your mind... and panicked.

Ezra.greeting: I watched the sunset from Mount Hokulani last night. Today I watch you fall!
Ezra.trainerLoses: The sun set on me this time...

Sika.greeting: I've cleaned this whole tree from top to bottom. I know every inch of it!
Sika.trainerLoses: You know this place better than I do...

Sika.greeting: Alolan Muk eats the trash in Hau'oli. Mine gets extra helpings. It's hungry today!
Sika.trainerWins: Gobbled up! Muk says thanks for the meal.

Sika.greeting: These coveralls are stain-proof AND poison-proof. Let's get messy!
Sika.trainerWins: Still spotless! Not one drop of poison on me.
Sika.trainerLoses: There's a stain I'll never get out...

Paulo.greeting: A clean floor and a clean battle. That's how I like it.
Paulo.trainerWins: Spotless! Not a scuff on the floor or the battle.
Paulo.trainerLoses: This is one stain I can't scrub out...

Paulo.greeting: Salazzle and Toxicroak are my poison cleaning crew!
Paulo.trainerWins: Disinfected! My poison crew does a thorough job.
Paulo.trainerLoses: Contaminated... I'll need a stronger cleaner.

Paulo.greeting: I clean the Pokémon Center here, too. Your team will need it after this!
Paulo.trainerLoses: I'll be using it myself, I think...

Dan.greeting: I've built bridges across Alola. A win streak is just another bridge!
Ampharos lights up the work site at night. Bright enough to beat you!
Dan.trainerWins: Lights on, winner! Ampharos never dims.

Dan.greeting: Knee pads, hard hat, gloves. I'm geared up!
Dan.trainerWins: The gear works! Safety AND victory!
Dan.trainerLoses: My gear's busted... and so is my streak.

Omar.greeting: Hard work pays off. Let's see whose work pays more today!
Omar.trainerWins: My hard work wins this round!

Omar.greeting: I helped build the stairs up to the Battle Tree. Climb 'em okay?
Omar.trainerWins: Built to last, like those stairs!

Omar.greeting: Nidoking and Nidoqueen dig my foundations. Strongest workers on the site!
Omar.trainerWins: Foundation laid! Nidoking and Nidoqueen never quit.

Mechabob.greeting: Ah, a worthy challenger at last. Let us battle as gentlemen do.
