Mechabob.trainerWins: A gentleman's victory. Thank you for the match.
Mechabob.trainerLoses: I would tip my hat to you, if I wore one.

Mechabob.greeting: Regirock, Regice and Registeel. I collect titans the way others collect seashells.
Mechabob.trainerWins: Titanic! My seashell collection holds strong.
Mechabob.trainerLoses: Even titans fall... I'll stick to seashells.

Mechabob.greeting: This shirt has hibiscus on it. Lovely flowers. Lovely battles.
Mechabob.trainerLoses: Less lovely now... even the hibiscus is drooping.

Abel.greeting: I've battled in the finest establishments in the world. This tree is quite charming.
Abel.trainerWins: A charming victory to end the day.
Abel.trainerLoses: Charming tree, charming defeat. Most memorable.

Abel.greeting: Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion... the Swords of Justice serve a gentleman well.
Abel.trainerWins: Justice served, as a gentleman should serve it!

Abel.greeting: My beard took forty years to grow. My team took fifty to assemble.

Donny.greeting: Darling, my Pokémon are dressed for a victory party.
Latias and Latios fly me home to my estate in Malie. Such dears!
Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf: knowledge, emotion and willpower, darling. I have them all.
Donny.trainerLoses: I seem to have lost my willpower...

Gracie.greeting: I simply adore battling. Shall we make this delightful?
Gracie.trainerLoses: Not delightful at all... for me, anyway.

Gracie.greeting: Cresselia gives me the sweetest dreams in my Hano suite. Tonight, I'll dream of your loss.
My green dress matches the jungle, darling. Kommo-o matches my temper.
Gracie.trainerWins: Ferocious! Kommo-o and I are in a lovely mood now.
Gracie.trainerLoses: Temper, temper... I'm afraid I've lost mine.

Donna.greeting: I've served the finest guests in Alola. Allow me to serve you a defeat!
Donna.trainerWins: Your defeat, served with a smile!
Donna.trainerLoses: It seems you're the one who served me.

Donna.greeting: Hariyama carries the heaviest bags at the resort. One shove and you're out!
Donna.trainerWins: Shoved right out! Hariyama's the strongest porter around.

Donna.greeting: I bow to every guest. Please bow back after you lose!

Gilroy.greeting: Room service! One battle, extra tough, coming right up!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Order delivered! Extra tough, as requested.
Gilroy.trainerLoses: I think I mixed up the order...

Gilroy.greeting: My slicked-back hair survives the Poni winds. My team survives anything!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Unshaken! Not a hair out of place.
Gilroy.trainerLoses: My hair's a mess. So's my team.

Gilroy.greeting: Scrafty and Toxicroak handle check-in. Pushy, but effective!
Gilroy.trainerWins: Checked in! Enjoy your stay in the loser's suite.

Patrick.greeting: Lowest handicap at my golf club in Hau'oli. Let's see yours!
Patrick.trainerLoses: My handicap just went way up...

Patrick.greeting: Charizard and Salamence carry my bag around the course. Strong caddies!
Patrick.trainerWins: Great caddies! Charizard didn't even singe the bag.

Patrick.greeting: Mid-swing is my best pose. Keep your eye on the ball... it's heading for your team!
Patrick.trainerLoses: Shanked it... right into the ocean.

Moe.greeting: One swing. That's all I need. That, and seven Eeveelutions.
Moe.trainerWins: One swing, one win. Seven Eeveelutions, zero misses.

Moe.greeting: Espeon in the day, Umbreon at night. I golf around the clock!
Moe.trainerLoses: Time to call it a night...

Moe.greeting: My red polo's lucky. Leafeon, Glaceon and Flareon are lucky too!
Moe.trainerWins: Lucky polo, lucky Pokémon, lucky me!
Moe.trainerLoses: Luck ran out... maybe I need a new polo.

Bruce.greeting: I hit the green every time. Seven Eeveelutions, seven perfect shots!
Bruce.trainerWins: On the green again! Seven for seven!

Bruce.greeting: Glaceon for cold days, Flareon for hot ones. Every condition is covered!
Bruce.trainerLoses: Weather delay... even with every Eeveelution ready.

Bruce.greeting: Red polo, red visor, red-hot swing! Fore!
Bruce.trainerWins: Fore, and done! Red-hot swing, red-hot win!
Bruce.trainerLoses: Foul ball... my red-hot swing cooled off.

Susanna.greeting: Golf is a gentle sport. Battling... is not!
Susanna.trainerLoses: I'll stick to gentle sports for a while...

Susanna.greeting: Volcarona's wings light up the course at dusk. I golf until the stars come out.
Susanna.trainerWins: A starlit win! Volcarona lit the way.
Susanna.trainerLoses: The stars came out... on my loss.

Susanna.greeting: I teach golf at the Hano Grand Resort. Lesson one: never underestimate me.
Susanna.trainerWins: Lesson learned! Never underestimate the instructor.

Lori.greeting: My Pokémon have perfect stats, especially their low Speed. Trick Room loves that!
Snorlax, Slowbro, Steelix... slow and steady, raised with love on the ranch.
Lori.trainerWins: Slow and steady, just like we practiced on the ranch!

Lori.greeting: I brush every Pokémon at dawn, before the Paniola Tauros wake up.

Colby.greeting: Raising Pokémon is an art. My masterpiece just happens to be a slow one!
Colby.trainerWins: A true masterpiece, slow and beautiful!
Colby.trainerLoses: My masterpiece needs a few more brushstrokes...

Colby.greeting: Reuniclus twists the room, and my heavyweights take over!
Colby.trainerWins: Twisted! My heavyweights took over, as planned.
Colby.trainerLoses: Untwisted... my heavyweights got left behind.

Colby.greeting: This glove has handled a thousand Eggs. Every one hatched a winner!
Colby.trainerWins: Another winner! This glove's never wrong.
Colby.trainerLoses: Not this one... even my glove's surprised.

Danby.greeting: Toxapex, Golisopod, Mudsdale: born and raised in Alola, just like me!
Danby.trainerWins: Alolan pride! Born and raised strong!

Danby.greeting: Slow and steady wins the race. Turtonator agrees!
My braids, my hat, my ranch. My Pokémon love it there, and you'll see why!
Danby.trainerWins: Ranch strength! Now you see why they love it there.

Izel.greeting: I've raised champions before. This team is my finest work!
Izel.trainerLoses: Perhaps not my finest after all...

Izel.greeting: Palossand was just a sandcastle on Hano Beach once. Now it's a champion!
Wishiwashi alone is tiny, but raised with care, it forms a mighty school!

Presta.greeting: When the alarm rings, I'm ready. And it's ringing now!
Presta.trainerLoses: False alarm... for my victory, anyway.

Presta.greeting: Wailord holds more water than any fire truck in Alola!
Presta.trainerWins: Flooded! Wailord's tank never runs out.
Presta.trainerLoses: Ran dry... even Wailord's tank has limits.

Presta.greeting: Yellow stripes, so you can see me through the smoke. You'll see me win, too.
Presta.trainerWins: Clear as day! Those stripes never lie.

Calder.greeting: I've walked through flames to save Pokémon. This battle is nothing!
Calder.trainerWins: Through the flames and out the other side!
Calder.trainerLoses: Those were flames I couldn't walk through...

Calder.greeting: Gastrodon and Slowbro: the slowest hoses in Alola, but the strongest!
Calder.trainerWins: A steady stream! Slow, but unstoppable.

Calder.greeting: I watch Akala's dry hills for brush fires. Today, I'm putting out your streak!
Calder.trainerWins: Extinguished! Akala's hills are safe from your streak.

Larry.greeting: My recipes have won awards. So have my Pokémon!
Larry.trainerLoses: Not every recipe can be a winner...

Larry.greeting: Kalua pig needs a good fire pit. Camerupt makes the best one!
Larry.trainerWins: Perfectly roasted! Camerupt's fire pit never fails.
Larry.trainerLoses: Undercooked... Camerupt's fire pit went out.

Larry.greeting: My apron's clean, but not for long. Let's make a mess!
Larry.trainerWins: A delicious mess! My apron's ruined, but who cares?

Tony.greeting: Prepare yourself for a five-course battle!
Tony.trainerLoses: I couldn't even get past the appetizer...

Tony.greeting: Haupia for dessert, but first, the main course: your team!
Houndoom grills, Glalie freezes. My kitchen runs hot and cold!
Tony.trainerLoses: Lukewarm at best... my kitchen's lost its edge.

Sam.greeting: Only the best Pokémon from every corner of the world made my team!
Sam.trainerWins: Only the best, as I said!
Sam.trainerLoses: Perhaps I'll add you to my collection of rivals.

Sam.greeting: Archeops, Armaldo, Cradily... my fossils are older than Alola's oldest ruins!
Sam.trainerWins: An ancient victory! Older than history itself.
Sam.trainerLoses: Back to the museum display case...

Sam.greeting: Porygon2 and Porygon-Z are digital rarities. Upgraded and ready!
Sam.trainerWins: Upgraded and victorious! Version 2.0 works perfectly.
Sam.trainerLoses: Looks like I need a patch...

Dennis.greeting: My collection holds the rarest Pokémon around. Prepare to be amazed!
Dennis.trainerLoses: You're even rarer than my Pokémon...

Dennis.greeting: Spiritomb's Odd Keystone took me a year to find. Worth it!
I keep my hair neat and my Pokémon polished. A collector's habit.

Horace.greeting: I've been at the top of this tree for years. I don't plan on stepping down.
Horace.trainerWins: The top is where I belong.
Horace.trainerLoses: Maybe it's time for someone new at the top.

Horace.greeting: Regirock, Regice and Registeel: ancient titans guard my summit!
Horace.trainerWins: The titans stand! My summit remains mine.

Horace.greeting: I traveled to Sinnoh's lakes for Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf. Worth every mile!
Horace.trainerWins: Worth the trip to Sinnoh! Every mile!
Horace.trainerLoses: A long trip home to think about this...

Perri.greeting: I've healed thousands of Pokémon at the Poni Pokémon Center. I know how strong they get!
Perri.trainerWins: Shall I heal your Pokémon for you? They've earned a rest.
Perri.trainerLoses: Now my own team needs healing. Come back anytime!

Perri.greeting: Blissey and Audino are my nursing staff. Healthy team, happy Trainer!
Pink dress, white apron, and a team ready to battle. Surprised?

Dooley.greeting: I've battled Champions and Legends. You'll have to be something special.
Dooley.trainerLoses: Something special indeed. The future's in good hands.

Dooley.greeting: Dragonite, Tyranitar, Metagross, Garchomp: the toughest team in Alola!
Dooley.trainerWins: Toughest in Alola, like I said!

Dooley.greeting: This leather jacket is older than the Alola League. So is my experience.
Dooley.trainerWins: Experience wins! Older than the League, and still winning.
Dooley.trainerLoses: You're in a league of your own...

Demiathena.greeting: My name is known in every battle hall in the world. Have you heard it?
Demiathena.trainerLoses: I'll be sure to remember your name, too.

Demiathena.greeting: Latias, Latios, Azelf, Uxie, Mesprit... I collect psychic legends like seashells.
Demiathena.trainerLoses: Lost a seashell... my collection feels smaller.

Demiathena.greeting: I watched the Alola League open from the front row. Now I'm making history here.
Demiathena.trainerWins: History made! Front row to my own victory!

Red.trainerWins: … (Red tugs his cap down and turns back to the view.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (Red smiles faintly and gives you a nod.)

Red.greeting: … (Red glances at Charizard's, Venusaur's and Blastoise's Poké Balls. Old friends, ready again.)
Red.trainerWins: … (Red recalls his Pokémon one by one, thanking each with a quiet nod.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (Red pats Charizard's Poké Ball, then tips his cap to you.)

Red.greeting: … (The sea breeze off Poni Island tugs at Red's cap. He doesn't notice. He's watching you.)
Red.trainerWins: … (Red settles his cap against the breeze and looks back out to sea.)
Red.trainerLoses: … (The breeze finally lifts Red's cap. He catches it, and, for once, he grins.)

Blue.greeting: So you're the one everybody's talking about? I'm the strongest Trainer around, so this'll be quick!
Blue.trainerWins: Ha! Told you I'm the strongest. Come back when you've grown up a bit!
Blue.trainerLoses: What?! Me, lose? ...Fine. Maybe I'm only the second strongest.

Blue.greeting: Alola's sea breeze is nice and all, but I didn't come for the view. I came to show who's the best!
Blue.trainerWins: Showed 'em! Enjoy the view on your way down.
Blue.trainerLoses: Tch. Fine, you can have the view. ...And the win.

Blue.greeting: I was Champion once, you know. For about five minutes. Don't you dare make this worse!
Blue.trainerLoses: Great. Now I've got two short reigns to live down.

Grimsley.greeting: Life is a gamble, and a battle is the finest bet of all. Shall we roll the dice?
Grimsley.trainerWins: The dice favored me today. Fortune is fickle, so try your luck again.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: I bet everything and lost. Ah, but what a thrilling gamble it was.

Grimsley.greeting: Alola's sunshine suits a gambler. Every day is a fresh deal. Shall we see what we're dealt?
Grimsley.trainerWins: A winning hand. The Alolan sun smiles on me today.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: You were dealt the better hand. I fold, gracefully.

Grimsley.greeting: Dark-types and dice both reward the bold. Show me how bold you are.
Grimsley.trainerWins: Bold, but not bold enough. Fortune favors me today.
Grimsley.trainerLoses: Bold indeed. I'd wager you'll go far.

Anabel.greeting: I can sense the bond between a Trainer and their Pokémon. Yours is strong... let's see how strong.
Anabel.trainerWins: Your bond is strong, but mine was stronger today.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Your bond is even stronger than I sensed. Remarkable.

Anabel.greeting: Looker sends his regards. Hunting Ultra Beasts is tiring, so a battle makes a nice change of pace.
Anabel.trainerWins: A refreshing change. I'll tell Looker you put up a good fight.
Anabel.trainerLoses: Looker will be surprised I lost. Don't tell him I enjoyed it.

Anabel.greeting: I was a Frontier Brain once. The Battle Tree feels like home. Show me your best.
Anabel.trainerWins: Just like the old Battle Frontier days. Your team has heart, but not enough yet.
Anabel.trainerLoses: You'd have made a fine Battle Frontier challenger. Splendid.

Wally.greeting: I used to be too frail to even leave home. Now look how far my Pokémon have taken me!
Wally.trainerWins: We've come so far together. You'll get there too!
Wally.trainerLoses: Still so much further to go... but I'll keep climbing!

Wally.greeting: Gallade and I trained all the way from Hoenn for this. I'm not that shy kid anymore!
Wally.trainerWins: See? Not the shy kid anymore. Thank you for battling me!
Wally.trainerLoses: Still not shy... just beaten. Gallade and I will keep training!

Wally.greeting: The ocean air in Alola is so good for my health. I feel strong enough to win!
Wally.trainerWins: The ocean air worked! I've never felt better!
Wally.trainerLoses: I feel great even after losing. Alola really is good for me.

Colress.greeting: I'm researching how to draw out a Pokémon's full potential. You'll make a fine test subject.
Colress.trainerWins: Fascinating. Your potential has limits... for now.
Colress.trainerLoses: Marvelous! You've drawn out potential beyond my calculations!

Colress.greeting: Alola's Z-Power fascinates me. Let's measure how much power your bond with your Pokémon holds.
Colress.trainerWins: Data collected. Your bond is strong, but my readings say mine is stronger.
Colress.trainerLoses: Remarkable readings! Your bond overloaded my instruments!

Colress.greeting: Magnezone, Klinklang, Porygon-Z: machines and Pokémon, both tools for discovery. Shall we discover something?
Colress.trainerWins: We discovered something: you have room to grow!
Colress.trainerLoses: We discovered something: I underestimated you. Fascinating!

Cynthia.greeting: I came to Alola to study its legends. A battle with you might be worth studying too.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A good battle, though not quite a legendary one. Keep growing.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: That was a legendary battle. I'll remember it alongside the old stories.

Cynthia.greeting: Sinnoh has its legends; Alola has its guardian Tapus. Let's battle like legends would.
Cynthia.trainerWins: A battle worthy of the Tapus' attention, if not quite legendary yet.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Even the Tapus would have watched that battle closely. Wonderful.

Cynthia.greeting: Garchomp loves the warm sand here. It's itching to battle. Are you ready?
Cynthia.trainerWins: Garchomp enjoyed that. Come back when your team can match its speed.
Cynthia.trainerLoses: Garchomp has never been outpaced like that. A splendid battle.

Plumeria.greeting: So you're the kid giving my grunts so much trouble? Time somebody taught you some manners.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Manners taught. Now run along, kid.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Tch... you've got more manners than I gave you credit for. And more skill.

Plumeria.greeting: Po Town's rain gets old. Climbing up here to crush some kid's streak? Nice change.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Streak crushed. Now that's a nice change.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Ugh. Back to the rain in Po Town, I guess.

Plumeria.greeting: Salazzle and I don't play nice. Big sister Plumeria's gonna teach you a lesson.
Plumeria.trainerWins: Class dismissed, kid. Big sis wins.
Plumeria.trainerLoses: Okay, kid. Big sis learned a lesson today.

Guzma.greeting: Big bad Guzma came all the way up this tree just to wreck your streak!
Guzma.trainerWins: That's how it's done! Nobody wrecks Guzma. Guzma does the wrecking!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Wrecked... AGAIN?! Why does this keep happening to me?!

Guzma.greeting: Golisopod and me, we're the strongest bugs on these islands! Ain't nobody squashing us!
Guzma.trainerWins: Told ya! Nobody squashes Guzma and Golisopod!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Squashed... flat. Like a bug. UGH, just like a bug!

Guzma.greeting: Team Skull's boss don't need a Z-Ring. I got pure destruction right here!
Guzma.trainerWins: Pure destruction! That's the Guzma way!
Guzma.trainerLoses: Destroyed... Guzma got destroyed. What is WRONG with this place?!

Kiawe.greeting: My Fire-type Pokémon burn with the passion of Wela Volcano! Feel the heat!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Was the heat too much? Train hard and face the volcano again!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Your spirit burned even hotter than the volcano. I salute you!

Kiawe.greeting: I dance the fire dance at Wela Volcano Park every night. Watch my Z-pose burn!
Kiawe.trainerWins: My fire dance never fails! Train hard and face it again!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: My fire dance fell flat... I'll practice until dawn!

Kiawe.greeting: Alolan Marowak and I guard the volcano together. Feel its blazing spirit!
Kiawe.trainerWins: Marowak's flame shines brightest! Come back stronger!
Kiawe.trainerLoses: Your spirit outshone even Marowak's flame. Truly impressive!

Mallow.greeting: I've cooked up a special battle menu just for you. Hope you've got an appetite!
Mallow.trainerWins: Seconds, anyone? You look like you've had enough!
Mallow.trainerLoses: You devoured my whole menu! I'll have to cook up something new.

Mallow.greeting: I picked these ingredients fresh from the Lush Jungle! Today's special: a Grass-type feast!
Mallow.trainerWins: Fresh from the jungle and served to perfection!
Mallow.trainerLoses: My jungle feast got eaten up! I'll forage for better ingredients!

Mallow.greeting: Tsareena kicks as hard as my secret recipe is spicy! Ready for a taste?
Mallow.trainerWins: Spicy, right? Tsareena seasoned it just right!
Mallow.trainerLoses: Too much spice even for Tsareena... back to the kitchen!

Sina.greeting: Dexio and I came all the way from Kalos to research Alola's Pokémon. Let's battle!
Sina.trainerWins: That was great research! I can't wait to tell Dexio all about it!
Sina.trainerLoses: I'll have to report this loss to Dexio... he'll never let me hear the end of it!

Sina.greeting: Alolan Sandslash and Glaceon love the snow on Lanakila! Can your team take the chill?
Sina.trainerWins: Brrr-illiant! I can't wait to tell Dexio!
Sina.trainerLoses: We got frozen out... Dexio's going to tease me forever!

Sina.greeting: Dexio thinks I'm too cheerful for serious battles. Let's prove him wrong together!
Sina.trainerWins: Cheerful AND victorious! Take that, Dexio!
Sina.trainerLoses: Okay, maybe Dexio had a point. I'm still smiling, though!

Dexio.greeting: Sina and I are studying Alola's Pokémon. A battle with you should be very educational.
Dexio.trainerWins: Educational indeed. I'll write this one up for the professor.
Dexio.trainerLoses: Quite the lesson. Sina will laugh when she hears about this one.

Dexio.greeting: We're searching Alola for Zygarde Cells. A battle makes a pleasant break from the hunt.
